ECLIPSORA.Pokedex: Domina el campo de batalla con su sola presencia. Mientras su aura nubla la visión del enemigo, sus lianas descargan golpes demoledores desde las sombras.

GOLISOPOD,2.Pokedex: Es un maestro del combate que maneja sus seis brazos con gran precisión. Su mirada intimida a sus rivales, y todo aquel que intenta huir cae bajo sus garras de terracota.

MIMALITY.Pokedex: Tras dominar el arte de la pantomima, puede doblegar la realidad a su voluntad y atrapar a sus enemigos en un mundo absurdo creado por él mismo.

MORTURNE.Pokedex: Tras proteger incansablemente los huertos, Morturne ha aprendido a plantar cara a los Pokémon de tipo Volador que acechan los cultivos. Nunca deja escapar a su presa.

NAUSSITCHD.Pokedex: El pesado bulbo que carga suele marearlo. Su entrenamiento determina su futuro: fortalecer su cuerpo le otorga poder, mientras que entrenar su velocidad lo convierte en un hábil espadachín.

STALACTREE.Pokedex: Habita en las profundidades de las cuevas, donde permanece inmóvil mientras gotea agua mineral. Su aspecto imita a la perfección el de un pilar de piedra.

TENKIFETCHD.Pokedex: Siempre lleva consigo un tallo de alguna planta, y se dice que algunos son mejores que otros. Es conocido por enfrentarse a otros Pokémon para conseguir sus tallos favoritos.

THUNDARTIC.Pokedex: Una bestia mítica de la que se dice que trae consigo tormentas eléctricas. Sus puños crepitan con rayos y su aliento desata ventiscas heladas.

TSURIGO.Pokedex: Pliega su cuerpo como si fuera de papel para amortiguar el primer golpe que recibe. Sus alas cortan el aire como hojas afiladas.

TYPHLOSION,2.Pokedex: La megaevolución ha cargado su pelaje de electricidad estática. Typhlosion libera descargas que abrasan el suelo a cada paso que da.

WIMPOD,2.Pokedex: Posee una voluntad inquebrantable y jamás cede terreno. Oculta sus extremidades bajo una pesada coraza de barro que hace casi imposible moverlo por la fuerza.

ANCIENTVIGOR.Name: Vigor Ancestral
ANCIENTVIGOR.Description: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado y puede aumentar su Defensa y Defensa Especial.

AUREOLAFLARE.Name: Aureola Ígnea
AUREOLAFLARE.Description: Libera una explosión de calor solar divino. Tiene una alta probabilidad de quemar al objetivo.

BEDROCKKICK.Description: Ataca al objetivo con una patada que posee la descomunal fuerza de la roca madre.
BEDROCKKICK.Name: Patada Basáltica

BERGMITESORTIE.Name: Asalto Bergmite
BERGMITESORTIE.Description: Golpea de dos a cinco veces. Cada impacto puede reducir la Velocidad del objetivo.

BLAZINGCLUB.Name: Garrote Ígneo
BLAZINGCLUB.Description: Ataca al objetivo con un garrote envuelto en llamas. Suele asestar golpes críticos. Si Furia Ardiente está cargada al máximo, ignora las pantallas.

BULBBASH.Name: Embate Bulbo
BULBBASH.Description: Golpea con su grueso bulbo. Puede reducir la Velocidad del objetivo.

CRAGSMASH.Name: Impacto Peñasco
CRAGSMASH.Description: Golpea violentamente al objetivo con una masa de roca endurecida. Puede hacerlo retroceder.

CRYSTALRAIN.Description: Invoca una intensa lluvia de cristales resplandecientes. Puede reducir la Defensa Especial de los Pokémon rivales.
CRYSTALRAIN.Name: Lluvia Cristalina

DYNASTICFANG.Description: Ataca con un poderoso mordisco. Obtiene +1 de prioridad si al objetivo le queda menos de la mitad de sus PS.
DYNASTICFANG.Name: Colmillo Imperial

GLACIERCRUNCH.Name: Colmillo Glacial
GLACIERCRUNCH.Description: Propina un mordisco gélido Es supereficaz contra los Pokémon de tipo Acero.

ICICLESLASH.Name: Corte Glacial
ICICLESLASH.Description: Acuchilla al objetivo con un afilado carámbano y reduce su Velocidad.

IONPULSE.Name: Pulso Iónico
IONPULSE.Description: Ataca con un pulso de energía ionizada altamente cargado que también quema al objetivo.

LIGHTNINGRUSH.Name: Asalto Relámpago
LIGHTNINGRUSH.Description: Electrifica su cuerpo y arremete sin preocuparse por su defensa. Reduce la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del usuario.

MOLTENSLAG.Name: Escoria Fundida
MOLTENSLAG.Description: Escupe escoria y alquitrán fundidos. Es supereficaz contra los Pokémon de tipo Acero y puede quemar al objetivo.

PIXIESMASH.Name: Golpe Mágico
PIXIESMASH.Description: Propina un poderoso golpe cargado de energía mágica. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.

PYROCLASM.Name: Piroclasma
PYROCLASM.Description: Dispara una devastadora descarga de ceniza volcánica sobrecalentada. Puede quemar al objetivo.

REACTIVETHORN.Description: Ataca con espinas usando la característica ofensiva más alta del usuario. Es supereficaz contra los tipos Volador y Bicho.
REACTIVETHORN.Name: Zarza Reactiva

ROYALBLIGHT.Name: Plaga Regia
ROYALBLIGHT.Description: Drena la fuerza vital del objetivo mediante una corrupta maldición real. El usuario recupera la mitad del daño causado.

SERPENTFLARE.Name: Serpellama
SERPENTFLARE.Description: Golpea de dos a cinco veces. Cada impacto puede quemar al objetivo.

SHADOWDECREE.Name: Decreto Sombrío
SHADOWDECREE.Description: Ejecuta un golpe definitivo imbuido con la autoridad del eclipse. Suele ser crítico e ignora los cambios de características del objetivo.

SKYSPLITTER.Name: Rompecielos
SKYSPLITTER.Description: Invoca un rayo desde los cielos que reduce la Velocidad del objetivo. Si llueve o nieva, también puede aumentar la Defensa del usuario.

SPECTRALSLASH.Description: Acuchilla al objetivo con una gélida hoja espectral. Puede reducir su Defensa.
SPECTRALSLASH.Name: Tajo Espectral

SPIKYGRASP.Name: Zarpa Espinosa
SPIKYGRASP.Description: Una zarpa espinosa golpea al objetivo, obligándolo a descender. Hace Supereficaz al tipo Volador.

SPIRALSTRIKE.Description: Golpea al objetivo con una ráfaga en espiral y aumenta la Velocidad del usuario.
SPIRALSTRIKE.Name: Asalto Espiral

STALAGMITEFALL.Name: Derrumbe Cárstico
STALAGMITEFALL.Description: Golpea al objetivo con la fuerza aplastante de una caverna. Puede hacerlo retroceder o reducir su Defensa.

STALKCUTTER.Name: Tallo Cortante
STALKCUTTER.Description: Ataca los puntos débiles del objetivo con un tallo afilado. Suele asestar golpes críticos.

SURREALMIME.Name: Pantomima Surreal
SURREALMIME.Description: Ejecuta una caótica actuación que atrapa al objetivo y lo obliga a seguir un guion carente de sentido.

TOGEBEAM.Name: Togerrayo
TOGEBEAM.Description: Cuanto más cariño le tenga Togepi a su Entrenador, mayor será la potencia del movimiento. Nunca falla.

TREMORPUNCH.Name: Puño Tectónico
TREMORPUNCH.Description: Golpea el suelo con el puño y transmite un temblor localizado hasta el objetivo. Puede reducir su Defensa.

VOLTBURST.Description: Sobrecarga el cuerpo de electricidad hasta hacerlo estallar, dañando a todos los Pokémon cercanos. El usuario se debilita.
VOLTBURST.Name: Estallido Voltaico

WARLORDSCRUSH.Description: Aplasta sin piedad al objetivo con garras de terracota. Duplica su potencia si el Ataque del objetivo ha disminuido.
WARLORDSCRUSH.Name: Garra Soberana

WEBSHOOTER.Name: Distelador
WEBSHOOTER.Description: Dispara redes pegajosas contra los Pokémon rivales y reduce su Velocidad.

BLAZINGVANGUARD.Description: Evita el daño de retroceso y reduce el daño recibido de movimientos físicos. Además, aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
BLAZINGVANGUARD.Name: Vanguardia Ígnea

BLESSEDCORONA.Name: Corona Bendita
BLESSEDCORONA.Description: Daña a los rivales al final de cada turno. Los aliados no pueden congelarse y aumenta la potencia de sus movimientos de tipo Fuego.

BLUDGEONMASTER.Name: Maestro de Mazas
BLUDGEONMASTER.Description: Aumenta un 50 % la potencia de los movimientos de martillo.

BURNINGRAMPAGE.Name: Furia Ardiente
BURNINGRAMPAGE.Description: Cada vez que recibe un golpe, sus movimientos de tipo Fuego aumentan un 10 % su potencia de forma acumulativa, hasta un máximo del 50 %. Además, no puede congelarse.

CRYSTALORBIT.Name: Órbita Cristalina
CRYSTALORBIT.Description: Sus pétalos giratorios reflejan los movimientos de estado y esparcen púas venenosas cuando recibe un ataque físico.

DELTAPLATING.Name: Coraza Delta
DELTAPLATING.Description: Reduce a la mitad el daño de movimientos supereficaces. Si recibe un golpe crítico, aumenta dos niveles su Velocidad.

FEUDALWARD.Name: Guardia Feudal
FEUDALWARD.Description: Reduce el daño recibido mientras conserva todos sus PS. Su presencia regia también bloquea los movimientos con prioridad.

FIREKNOCK.Description: Puede quemar al objetivo al entrar en contacto con él.
FIREKNOCK.Name: Toque Ardiente

FLEURDEMAL.Name: Flor Maldita
FLEURDEMAL.Description: Los movimientos que drenan PS recuperan más salud. Si el objetivo está envenenado, estos movimientos también infligen más daño.

FOLDEDGUARD.Description: La primera vez que recibe un golpe durante el combate, el daño se reduce a la mitad.
FOLDEDGUARD.Name: Defensa Plegada

FROSTEDGE.Description: Los movimientos de corte y de contacto tienen un 20 % de probabilidad de congelar al objetivo si este tiene alguna característica reducida. Durante el granizo, aumenta un 20 % la Velocidad.
FROSTEDGE.Name: Escarcha Cortante

HABBAKUKHULL.Name: Coraza Habbakuk
HABBAKUKHULL.Description: Reduce a la mitad el daño de movimientos de tipo Fuego, Lucha y Roca. Los aliados reciben un 25 % menos de daño de movimientos que afectan a varios objetivos.

HIDDENARSENAL.Name: Arsenal Secreto
HIDDENARSENAL.Description: Los movimientos que golpean varias veces siempre alcanzan su número máximo de impactos. Los movimientos con prioridad aumentan un 50 % su potencia.

INCANDESCENCE.Name: Incandescencia
INCANDESCENCE.Description: Aumenta la Defensa y el Ataque Especial bajo el sol o al recibir un movimiento de tipo Fuego. Los atacantes que hagan contacto también pueden acabar quemados.

IRONCLAD.Name: Coraza Férrea
IRONCLAD.Description: Reduce a la mitad el daño físico recibido. Sus movimientos físicos utilizan la Defensa en lugar del Ataque para calcular el daño.

MINERALDRIP.Name: Manantial Mineral
MINERALDRIP.Description: Recupera PS al final de cada turno. Durante una tormenta de arena, recupera aún más PS.

OBSIDIANSHELL.Name: Coraza Obsidiana
OBSIDIANSHELL.Description: Reduce el daño recibido de movimientos de tipo Agua y Tierra. Al recibir un ataque, esparce afiladas esquirlas alrededor del rival y aumenta su Defensa y Defensa Especial.

OVERAWE.Name: Gran Pavor
OVERAWE.Description: Intimida a los Pokémon rivales al entrar en combate y reduce su Ataque Especial.

OVERCHARGE.Name: Sobrecarga
OVERCHARGE.Description: Aumenta el Ataque después de acertar un movimiento de contacto o uno que cause daño de retroceso.

PERMAFROSTJAW.Name: Fauce Glacial
PERMAFROSTJAW.Description: Potencia los movimientos de mordisco y les permite ignorar los efectos defensivos de la habilidad del objetivo.

PRECOGNITION.Name: Precognición
PRECOGNITION.Description: Es inmune a los movimientos con prioridad. Sus movimientos de tipo Fuego y Psíquico nunca fallan e ignoran Protección y las pantallas.

PRIDE.Name: Soberbia
PRIDE.Description: Aumenta el Ataque Especial cada vez que debilita a un Pokémon rival.

PRIMALTOUGH.Description: Reduce el daño recibido de movimientos de tipo Roca, pero aumenta el daño que recibe de movimientos de tipo Hielo.
PRIMALTOUGH.Name: Temple Primitivo

REACTIVEPOLLEN.Description: Si recibe un ataque físico, libera esporas que reducen el Ataque y la Velocidad del atacante. Si recibe uno especial, reduce su Ataque Especial y Velocidad.
REACTIVEPOLLEN.Name: Polen Reactivo

SKYSNARE.Name: Trampa Celeste
SKYSNARE.Description: Atrapa a los rivales de tipo Volador y reduce a la mitad el daño recibido de sus movimientos de tipo Volador.

SQUIRESWILL.Name: Lealtad de Escudero
SQUIRESWILL.Description: Al quedarse con la mitad de sus PS o menos, aumenta mucho todas sus características. Mientras tenga pocos PS, no puede retroceder ni ser expulsado del combate.

STARRYREACH.Name: Impulso Estelar
STARRYREACH.Description: Los movimientos de estado y de puño obtienen prioridad +1. Además, duplica la probabilidad de los efectos secundarios de los movimientos de puño.

STORMLORD.Name: Heraldo de la tormenta
STORMLORD.Description: Los movimientos de contacto pueden paralizar al atacante. Durante la lluvia o la nieve, los movimientos físicos también restauran PS.

STRIKER.Name: Gran Pateador
STRIKER.Description: Aumenta un 50 % la potencia de los movimientos de patada.

THERMALFRONT.Name: Corriente Térmica
THERMALFRONT.Description: Otorga inmunidad a los movimientos de tipo Tierra. Además, permite que los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico alcancen a Pokémon de tipo Tierra.

TOONLOGIC.Name: Lógica Animada
TOONLOGIC.Description: La realidad se distorsiona al recibir un golpe y desencadena al azar una jugarreta teatral que altera el combate.

UMBRAVEIL.Name: Manto Umbrío
UMBRAVEIL.Description: Cubre el campo con una niebla de eclipse durante cinco turnos. Los aliados son inmunes a los golpes críticos y a las reducciones de características, y los movimientos de Luz quedan debilitados mientras dure el velo.

WARLORDSGAZE.Name: Temple Bélico
WARLORDSGAZE.Description: Intimida a los rivales al entrar en combate reduciendo su Ataque. Además, golpea a cualquier oponente que intente huir.

CHANGEDEX.Name: Mutadex
CHANGEDEX.Description: Un registro de los cambios realizados a especies ya existentes en este juego, como tipos, características, habilidades y nuevos movimientos aprendidos.

FERROUSTAR.Description: Una densa sustancia metálica acumulada por Durant. Permite a cierto Pokémon forjar una coraza de acero y evolucionar.
FERROUSTAR.Name: Alquitrán Ferroso

RADAR.Name: Radar Pokémon
RADAR.Description: Un dispositivo que muestra los Pokémon que pueden encontrarse en la zona actual.

REALITYORB.Name: Orbe de Realidad
REALITYORB.Description: Un misterioso orbe resplandeciente creado por un maestro de la pantomima. Permite a ciertos Pokémon materializar sus pensamientos y evolucionar.

SLEEPINGBAG.Name: Saco de Dormir
SLEEPINGBAG.Description: Un saco de dormir que permite descansar y hacer avanzar el tiempo hasta un momento concreto del día.

STORMRUNE.Name: Runa de Tormenta
STORMRUNE.Description: Una antigua piedra cubierta de runas que vibra con electricidad. Hace evolucionar a ciertos Pokémon y potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.

TYPHLOSIONITE.Name: Typhlosionita
TYPHLOSIONITE.Description: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Si la lleva Typhlosion, podrá megaevolucionar.

BULBASAUR.Name: Bulbasaur
BULBASAUR.Pokedex: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

IVYSAUR.Name: Ivysaur
IVYSAUR.Pokedex: To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.

VENUSAUR.Name: Venusaur
VENUSAUR.Pokedex: Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.

SUNKERN.Name: Sunkern
SUNKERN.Pokedex: Sunkern try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

VENUSAUR,1.Name: Venusaur
VENUSAUR,1.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

CHARMANDER.Name: Charmander
CHARMANDER.Pokedex: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

CHARMELEON.Name: Charmeleon
CHARMELEON.Pokedex: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

CHARIZARD.Name: Charizard
CHARIZARD.Pokedex: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

FLAREON.Name: Flareon
FLAREON.Pokedex: Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

INFERNAPE.Name: Infernape
INFERNAPE.Pokedex: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

CHARIZARD,1.Name: Charizard
CHARIZARD,1.Pokedex: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

CHARIZARD,2.Name: Charizard
CHARIZARD,2.Pokedex: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

SQUIRTLE.Name: Squirtle
SQUIRTLE.Pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

WARTORTLE.Name: Wartortle
WARTORTLE.Pokedex: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.

BLASTOISE.Name: Blastoise
BLASTOISE.Pokedex: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

BLASTOISE,1.Name: Blastoise
BLASTOISE,1.Pokedex: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

KABUTO.Name: Kabuto
KABUTO.Pokedex: This Pokémon has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. Kabuto have not changed for 300 million years.

KABUTOPS.Name: Kabutops
KABUTOPS.Pokedex: Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

CATERPIE.Name: Caterpie
CATERPIE.Pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

WURMPLE.Name: Wurmple
WURMPLE.Pokedex: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth becomes gooey when it touches air and slows the movement of its foes.

SNOM.Name: Snom
SNOM.Pokedex: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

METAPOD.Name: Metapod
METAPOD.Pokedex: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A Metapod does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.

KAKUNA.Name: Kakuna
KAKUNA.Pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

SILCOON.Name: Silcoon
SILCOON.Pokedex: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

CASCOON.Name: Cascoon
CASCOON.Pokedex: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

BUTTERFREE.Name: Butterfree
BUTTERFREE.Pokedex: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

BEAUTIFLY.Name: Beautifly
BEAUTIFLY.Pokedex: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

WEEDLE.Name: Weedle
WEEDLE.Pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

BEEDRILL.Name: Beedrill
BEEDRILL.Pokedex: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

BEEDRILL,1.Name: Beedrill
BEEDRILL,1.Pokedex: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

PIDGEY.Name: Pidgey
PIDGEY.Pokedex: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

SPEAROW.Name: Spearow
SPEAROW.Pokedex: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

NATU.Name: Natu
NATU.Pokedex: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

ROOKIDEE.Name: Rookidee
ROOKIDEE.Pokedex: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

PIDGEOTTO.Name: Pidgeotto
PIDGEOTTO.Pokedex: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

PIDGEOT.Name: Pidgeot
PIDGEOT.Pokedex: Pidgeot has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

PIDGEOT,1.Name: Pidgeot
PIDGEOT,1.Pokedex: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

RATTATA.Name: Rattata
RATTATA.Pokedex: A Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

RATTATA,1.Name: Rattata
RATTATA,1.Pokedex: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

RATICATE.Name: Raticate
RATICATE.Pokedex: A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

PIKACHU.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

RAICHU.Name: Raichu
RAICHU.Pokedex: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

SANDSHREW.Name: Sandshrew
SANDSHREW.Pokedex: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

SANDSLASH.Name: Sandslash
SANDSLASH.Pokedex: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.

PAWMI.Name: Pawmi
PAWMI.Pokedex: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

PAWMO.Name: Pawmo
PAWMO.Pokedex: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

RATICATE,1.Name: Raticate
RATICATE,1.Pokedex: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

PIKACHU,10.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

PIKACHU,11.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU,11.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

PIKACHU,12.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU,12.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

PIKACHU,13.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU,13.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

PIKACHU,14.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU,14.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

PIKACHU,15.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU,15.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

RAICHU,1.Name: Raichu
RAICHU,1.Pokedex: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.

RAICHU,2.Name: Raichu
RAICHU,2.Pokedex: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.

RAICHU,3.Name: Raichu
RAICHU,3.Pokedex: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

SANDSHREW,1.Name: Sandshrew
SANDSHREW,1.Pokedex: The skin on its back is as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly, so it clings to the ground desperately.

SANDSLASH,1.Name: Sandslash
SANDSLASH,1.Pokedex: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

FEAROW.Name: Fearow
FEAROW.Pokedex: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

EKANS.Name: Ekans
EKANS.Pokedex: An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

ARBOK.Name: Arbok
ARBOK.Pokedex: This Pokémon has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.

NIDORANFE.Name: Nidoran♀
NIDORANFE.Pokedex: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

NIDORINA.Name: Nidorina
NIDORINA.Pokedex: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

NIDORANMA.Name: Nidoran♂
NIDORANMA.Pokedex: The male Nidoran has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.

NIDORINO.Name: Nidorino
NIDORINO.Pokedex: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

POIPOLE.Name: Poipole
POIPOLE.Pokedex: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

NAGANADEL.Name: Naganadel
NAGANADEL.Pokedex: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

NIDOQUEEN.Name: Nidoqueen
NIDOQUEEN.Pokedex: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

NIDOKING.Name: Nidoking
NIDOKING.Pokedex: A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

RHYDON.Name: Rhydon
RHYDON.Pokedex: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

RHYPERIOR.Name: Rhyperior
RHYPERIOR.Pokedex: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

CLEFAIRY.Name: Clefairy
CLEFAIRY.Pokedex: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.

CLEFABLE.Name: Clefable
CLEFABLE.Pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

SNUBBULL.Name: Snubbull
SNUBBULL.Pokedex: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying in terror. The Snubbull does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.

GRANBULL.Name: Granbull
GRANBULL.Pokedex: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.

CLEFABLE,1.Name: Clefable
CLEFABLE,1.Pokedex: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

VULPIX.Name: Vulpix
VULPIX.Pokedex: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

VULPIX,1.Name: Vulpix
VULPIX,1.Pokedex: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

NINETALES.Name: Ninetales
NINETALES.Pokedex: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

FENNEKIN.Name: Fennekin
FENNEKIN.Pokedex: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

BRAIXEN.Name: Braixen
BRAIXEN.Pokedex: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

DELPHOX.Name: Delphox
DELPHOX.Pokedex: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

NICKIT.Name: Nickit
NICKIT.Pokedex: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

THIEVUL.Name: Thievul
THIEVUL.Pokedex: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

NINETALES,1.Name: Ninetales
NINETALES,1.Pokedex: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate. It appears draped in a blizzard.

DELPHOX,1.Name: Delphox
DELPHOX,1.Pokedex: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

JIGGLYPUFF.Name: Jigglypuff
JIGGLYPUFF.Pokedex: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a Jigglypuff's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

WIGGLYTUFF.Name: Wigglytuff
WIGGLYTUFF.Pokedex: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

IGGLYBUFF.Name: Igglybuff
IGGLYBUFF.Pokedex: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

QWILFISH.Name: Qwilfish
QWILFISH.Pokedex: A Qwilfish uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

DRIFLOON.Name: Drifloon
DRIFLOON.Pokedex: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

QWILFISH,1.Name: Qwilfish
QWILFISH,1.Pokedex: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

ZUBAT.Name: Zubat
ZUBAT.Pokedex: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

GOLBAT.Name: Golbat
GOLBAT.Pokedex: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

CROBAT.Name: Crobat
CROBAT.Pokedex: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

WOOBAT.Name: Woobat
WOOBAT.Pokedex: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

ODDISH.Name: Oddish
ODDISH.Pokedex: It grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

GLOOM.Name: Gloom
GLOOM.Pokedex: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

VILEPLUME.Name: Vileplume
VILEPLUME.Pokedex: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a Vileplume turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.

BELLSPROUT.Name: Bellsprout
BELLSPROUT.Pokedex: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

BELLOSSOM.Name: Bellossom
BELLOSSOM.Pokedex: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a sun-summoning ritual.

PARAS.Name: Paras
PARAS.Pokedex: A Paras has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.

PARASECT.Name: Parasect
PARASECT.Pokedex: Parasect are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.

SHROOMISH.Name: Shroomish
SHROOMISH.Pokedex: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

BRELOOM.Name: Breloom
BRELOOM.Pokedex: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

FOONGUS.Name: Foongus
FOONGUS.Pokedex: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

AMOONGUSS.Name: Amoonguss
AMOONGUSS.Pokedex: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

VENONAT.Name: Venonat
VENONAT.Pokedex: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.

VENOMOTH.Name: Venomoth
VENOMOTH.Pokedex: Venomoth are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

DUSTOX.Name: Dustox
DUSTOX.Pokedex: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

DIGLETT.Name: Diglett
DIGLETT.Pokedex: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.

DIGLETT,1.Name: Diglett
DIGLETT,1.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

DUGTRIO.Name: Dugtrio
DUGTRIO.Pokedex: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

DRILBUR.Name: Drilbur
DRILBUR.Pokedex: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

DUGTRIO,1.Name: Dugtrio
DUGTRIO,1.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

MEOWTH.Name: Meowth
MEOWTH.Pokedex: Meowth withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

MEOWTH,1.Name: Meowth
MEOWTH,1.Pokedex: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

MEOWTH,2.Name: Meowth
MEOWTH,2.Pokedex: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

PERSIAN.Name: Persian
PERSIAN.Pokedex: A Persian's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

PERSIAN,1.Name: Persian
PERSIAN,1.Pokedex: Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.

PSYDUCK.Name: Psyduck
PSYDUCK.Pokedex: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.

GOLDUCK.Name: Golduck
GOLDUCK.Pokedex: A Golduck is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

MANKEY.Name: Mankey
MANKEY.Pokedex: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

PRIMEAPE.Name: Primeape
PRIMEAPE.Pokedex: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

GROWLITHE.Name: Growlithe
GROWLITHE.Pokedex: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this Pokémon won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.

GROWLITHE,1.Name: Growlithe
GROWLITHE,1.Pokedex: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

LILLIPUP.Name: Lillipup
LILLIPUP.Pokedex: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

ROCKRUFF.Name: Rockruff
ROCKRUFF.Pokedex: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

YAMPER.Name: Yamper
YAMPER.Pokedex: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

FIDOUGH.Name: Fidough
FIDOUGH.Pokedex: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

ROCKRUFF,2.Name: Rockruff
ROCKRUFF,2.Pokedex: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

ARCANINE.Name: Arcanine
ARCANINE.Pokedex: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.

ARCANINE,1.Name: Arcanine
ARCANINE,1.Pokedex: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

POLIWAG.Name: Poliwag
POLIWAG.Pokedex: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

POLIWHIRL.Name: Poliwhirl
POLIWHIRL.Pokedex: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

POLIWRATH.Name: Poliwrath
POLIWRATH.Pokedex: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

TYMPOLE.Name: Tympole
TYMPOLE.Pokedex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

ABRA.Name: Abra
ABRA.Pokedex: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

KADABRA.Name: Kadabra
KADABRA.Pokedex: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

ALAKAZAM.Name: Alakazam
ALAKAZAM.Pokedex: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

ALAKAZAM,1.Name: Alakazam
ALAKAZAM,1.Pokedex: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

MACHOP.Name: Machop
MACHOP.Pokedex: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

MACHOKE.Name: Machoke
MACHOKE.Pokedex: A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

MACHAMP.Name: Machamp
MACHAMP.Pokedex: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.

WEEPINBELL.Name: Weepinbell
WEEPINBELL.Pokedex: At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

VICTREEBEL.Name: Victreebel
VICTREEBEL.Pokedex: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.

VICTREEBEL,1.Name: Victreebel
VICTREEBEL,1.Pokedex: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased and filling its mouth. If it's not careful, it will overflow and spill out.

TENTACOOL.Name: Tentacool
TENTACOOL.Pokedex: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.

TENTACRUEL.Name: Tentacruel
TENTACRUEL.Pokedex: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

GEODUDE.Name: Geodude
GEODUDE.Pokedex: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

GEODUDE,1.Name: Geodude
GEODUDE,1.Pokedex: Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

GRAVELER.Name: Graveler
GRAVELER.Pokedex: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and huge boulders with thunderous tackles.

GRAVELER,1.Name: Graveler
GRAVELER,1.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

GOLEM.Name: Golem
GOLEM.Pokedex: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

GOLEM,1.Name: Golem
GOLEM,1.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

PONYTA.Name: Ponyta
PONYTA.Pokedex: A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.

PONYTA,1.Name: Ponyta
PONYTA,1.Pokedex: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

RAPIDASH.Name: Rapidash
RAPIDASH.Pokedex: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a Rapidash turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

RAPIDASH,1.Name: Rapidash
RAPIDASH,1.Pokedex: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

SLOWPOKE.Name: Slowpoke
SLOWPOKE.Pokedex: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends whole days just loafing at the water's edge.

SLOWPOKE,1.Name: Slowpoke
SLOWPOKE,1.Pokedex: Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

SLOWBRO.Name: Slowbro
SLOWBRO.Pokedex: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

SLOWBRO,1.Name: Slowbro
SLOWBRO,1.Pokedex: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

SLOWBRO,2.Name: Slowbro
SLOWBRO,2.Pokedex: Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It's pretty comfortable in there, too.

MAGNEMITE.Name: Magnemite
MAGNEMITE.Pokedex: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

MAGNETON.Name: Magneton
MAGNETON.Pokedex: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

FARFETCHD.Name: Farfetch'd
FARFETCHD.Pokedex: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

FARFETCHD,1.Name: Farfetch'd
FARFETCHD,1.Pokedex: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

SIRFETCHD.Name: Sirfetch'd
SIRFETCHD.Pokedex: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

DODUO.Name: Doduo
DODUO.Pokedex: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

DODRIO.Name: Dodrio
DODRIO.Pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.

SEEL.Name: Seel
SEEL.Pokedex: Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

DEWGONG.Name: Dewgong
DEWGONG.Pokedex: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

POPPLIO.Name: Popplio
POPPLIO.Pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

GRIMER.Name: Grimer
GRIMER.Pokedex: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

GRIMER,1.Name: Grimer
GRIMER,1.Pokedex: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

MUK.Name: Muk
MUK.Pokedex: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making Muk reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

MUK,1.Name: Muk
MUK,1.Pokedex: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

SHELLDER.Name: Shellder
SHELLDER.Pokedex: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

CLOYSTER.Name: Cloyster
CLOYSTER.Pokedex: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

CLAMPERL.Name: Clamperl
CLAMPERL.Pokedex: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

GASTLY.Name: Gastly
GASTLY.Pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

HAUNTER.Name: Haunter
HAUNTER.Pokedex: If a Haunter beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

GENGAR.Name: Gengar
GENGAR.Pokedex: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

GENGAR,1.Name: Gengar
GENGAR,1.Pokedex: The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.

ONIX.Name: Onix
ONIX.Pokedex: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an Onix from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

DROWZEE.Name: Drowzee
DROWZEE.Pokedex: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

HYPNO.Name: Hypno
HYPNO.Pokedex: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a Hypno's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

KRABBY.Name: Krabby
KRABBY.Pokedex: Krabby live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

KINGLER.Name: Kingler
KINGLER.Pokedex: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.

SCIZOR.Name: Scizor
SCIZOR.Pokedex: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

SCIZOR,1.Name: Scizor
SCIZOR,1.Pokedex: It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.

VOLTORB.Name: Voltorb
VOLTORB.Pokedex: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran trainers treat it with caution.

VOLTORB,1.Name: Voltorb
VOLTORB,1.Pokedex: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

ELECTRODE.Name: Electrode
ELECTRODE.Pokedex: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

ELECTRODE,1.Name: Electrode
ELECTRODE,1.Pokedex: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

EXEGGCUTE.Name: Exeggcute
EXEGGCUTE.Pokedex: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

EXEGGCUTE,1.Name: Exeggcute
EXEGGCUTE,1.Pokedex: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

CHANSEY.Name: Chansey
CHANSEY.Pokedex: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those who have lost their appetite.

EXEGGUTOR.Name: Exeggutor
EXEGGUTOR.Pokedex: Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's heads grow larger with exposure to bright sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.

EXEGGUTOR,1.Name: Exeggutor
EXEGGUTOR,1.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

CUBONE.Name: Cubone
CUBONE.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

CUBONE,1.Name: Cubone
CUBONE,1.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

MAROWAK.Name: Marowak
MAROWAK.Pokedex: A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

MAROWAK,1.Name: Marowak
MAROWAK,1.Pokedex: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

HITMONLEE.Name: Hitmonlee
HITMONLEE.Pokedex: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

HITMONCHAN.Name: Hitmonchan
HITMONCHAN.Pokedex: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

LICKITUNG.Name: Lickitung
LICKITUNG.Pokedex: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

LICKILICKY.Name: Lickilicky
LICKILICKY.Pokedex: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

KOFFING.Name: Koffing
KOFFING.Pokedex: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

WEEZING.Name: Weezing
WEEZING.Pokedex: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be made. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

WEEZING,1.Name: Weezing
WEEZING,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

RHYHORN.Name: Rhyhorn
RHYHORN.Pokedex: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

TANGELA.Name: Tangela
TANGELA.Pokedex: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

TANGROWTH.Name: Tangrowth
TANGROWTH.Pokedex: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

KANGASKHAN.Name: Kangaskhan
KANGASKHAN.Pokedex: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

KANGASKHAN,1.Name: Kangaskhan
KANGASKHAN,1.Pokedex: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.

HORSEA.Name: Horsea
HORSEA.Pokedex: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

SEADRA.Name: Seadra
SEADRA.Pokedex: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

DRATINI.Name: Dratini
DRATINI.Pokedex: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

DRAGONAIR.Name: Dragonair
DRAGONAIR.Pokedex: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

DRAGONITE.Name: Dragonite
DRAGONITE.Pokedex: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

KINGDRA.Name: Kingdra
KINGDRA.Pokedex: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

SALAMENCE.Name: Salamence
SALAMENCE.Pokedex: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

GOODRA.Name: Goodra
GOODRA.Pokedex: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

DRAGONITE,1.Name: Dragonite
DRAGONITE,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.

SALAMENCE,1.Name: Salamence
SALAMENCE,1.Pokedex: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

GOLDEEN.Name: Goldeen
GOLDEEN.Pokedex: In the springtime, schools of Goldeen can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

SEAKING.Name: Seaking
SEAKING.Pokedex: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

STARYU.Name: Staryu
STARYU.Pokedex: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

CLEFFA.Name: Cleffa
CLEFFA.Pokedex: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

STARMIE.Name: Starmie
STARMIE.Pokedex: People in ancient times imagined that Starmie were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

STARMIE,1.Name: Starmie
STARMIE,1.Pokedex: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

MRMIME.Name: Mr. Mime
MRMIME.Pokedex: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

MRMIME,1.Name: Mr. Mime
MRMIME,1.Pokedex: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

SCYTHER.Name: Scyther
SCYTHER.Pokedex: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

JYNX.Name: Jynx
JYNX.Pokedex: A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

ELECTABUZZ.Name: Electabuzz
ELECTABUZZ.Pokedex: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use Electabuzz as lightning rods.

ZAPDOS.Name: Zapdos
ZAPDOS.Pokedex: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

ELEKID.Name: Elekid
ELEKID.Pokedex: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

MAGMAR.Name: Magmar
MAGMAR.Pokedex: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees.

PINSIR.Name: Pinsir
PINSIR.Pokedex: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

PINSIR,1.Name: Pinsir
PINSIR,1.Pokedex: It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for an opening to skewer its opponent on its giant pincers.

VIKAVOLT.Name: Vikavolt
VIKAVOLT.Pokedex: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

TAUROS.Name: Tauros
TAUROS.Pokedex: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

TAUROS,1.Name: Tauros
TAUROS,1.Pokedex: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

TAUROS,2.Name: Tauros
TAUROS,2.Pokedex: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

TAUROS,3.Name: Tauros
TAUROS,3.Pokedex: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

MAGIKARP.Name: Magikarp
MAGIKARP.Pokedex: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

FEEBAS.Name: Feebas
FEEBAS.Pokedex: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few trainers raise it.

GYARADOS.Name: Gyarados
GYARADOS.Pokedex: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

GYARADOS,1.Name: Gyarados
GYARADOS,1.Pokedex: It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even large ships caught in its path are split cleanly in two!

LAPRAS.Name: Lapras
LAPRAS.Pokedex: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

DITTO.Name: Ditto
DITTO.Pokedex: A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.

EEVEE.Name: Eevee
EEVEE.Pokedex: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

VAPOREON.Name: Vaporeon
VAPOREON.Pokedex: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

JOLTEON.Name: Jolteon
JOLTEON.Pokedex: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

PORYGON.Name: Porygon
PORYGON.Pokedex: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated.

PORYGON2.Name: Porygon2
PORYGON2.Pokedex: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

PORYGONZ.Name: Porygon-Z
PORYGONZ.Pokedex: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

OMANYTE.Name: Omanyte
OMANYTE.Pokedex: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.

OMASTAR.Name: Omastar
OMASTAR.Pokedex: An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

AERODACTYL.Name: Aerodactyl
AERODACTYL.Pokedex: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

AERODACTYL,1.Name: Aerodactyl
AERODACTYL,1.Pokedex: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.

DRACOZOLT.Name: Dracozolt
DRACOZOLT.Pokedex: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

ARCTOZOLT.Name: Arctozolt
ARCTOZOLT.Pokedex: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

DRACOVISH.Name: Dracovish
DRACOVISH.Pokedex: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

ARCTOVISH.Name: Arctovish
ARCTOVISH.Pokedex: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

SNORLAX.Name: Snorlax
SNORLAX.Pokedex: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

ARTICUNO.Name: Articuno
ARTICUNO.Pokedex: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

ARTICUNO,1.Name: Articuno
ARTICUNO,1.Pokedex: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

ZAPDOS,1.Name: Zapdos
ZAPDOS,1.Pokedex: When its feathers rub together, they produce a crackling sound like the zapping of electricity. That's why this Pokémon is called Zapdos.

MOLTRES.Name: Moltres
MOLTRES.Pokedex: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

MOLTRES,1.Name: Moltres
MOLTRES,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

MEWTWO.Name: Mewtwo
MEWTWO.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

MEWTWO,1.Name: Mewtwo
MEWTWO,1.Pokedex: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

MEWTWO,2.Name: Mewtwo
MEWTWO,2.Pokedex: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

MEW.Name: Mew
MEW.Pokedex: A Mew is said to possess the genes of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

CHIKORITA.Name: Chikorita
CHIKORITA.Pokedex: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

BAYLEEF.Name: Bayleef
BAYLEEF.Pokedex: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

MEGANIUM.Name: Meganium
MEGANIUM.Pokedex: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

MEGANIUM,1.Name: Meganium
MEGANIUM,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

CYNDAQUIL.Name: Cyndaquil
CYNDAQUIL.Pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

CYNDAQUIL,1.Name: Cyndaquil
CYNDAQUIL,1.Pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

QUILAVA.Name: Quilava
QUILAVA.Pokedex: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

QUILAVA,1.Name: Quilava
QUILAVA,1.Pokedex: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

TYPHLOSION.Name: Typhlosion
TYPHLOSION.Pokedex: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

ENTEI.Name: Entei
ENTEI.Pokedex: Entei embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.

TYPHLOSION,1.Name: Typhlosion
TYPHLOSION,1.Pokedex: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

TOTODILE.Name: Totodile
TOTODILE.Pokedex: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

CROCONAW.Name: Croconaw
CROCONAW.Pokedex: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

FERALIGATR.Name: Feraligatr
FERALIGATR.Pokedex: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

FERALIGATR,1.Name: Feraligatr
FERALIGATR,1.Pokedex: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

SENTRET.Name: Sentret
SENTRET.Pokedex: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one gets separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

PATRAT.Name: Patrat
PATRAT.Pokedex: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

FURRET.Name: Furret
FURRET.Pokedex: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

HOOTHOOT.Name: Hoothoot
HOOTHOOT.Pokedex: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

NOCTOWL.Name: Noctowl
NOCTOWL.Pokedex: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

LEDYBA.Name: Ledyba
LEDYBA.Pokedex: Ledyba communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

LEDIAN.Name: Ledian
LEDIAN.Pokedex: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

SPINARAK.Name: Spinarak
SPINARAK.Pokedex: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

ARIADOS.Name: Ariados
ARIADOS.Pokedex: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

CHINCHOU.Name: Chinchou
CHINCHOU.Pokedex: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

LANTURN.Name: Lanturn
LANTURN.Pokedex: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

AMPHAROS.Name: Ampharos
AMPHAROS.Pokedex: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

AMPHAROS,1.Name: Ampharos
AMPHAROS,1.Pokedex: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

PICHU.Name: Pichu
PICHU.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

PICHU,2.Name: Pichu
PICHU,2.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

TOGEPI.Name: Togepi
TOGEPI.Pokedex: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

TOGETIC.Name: Togetic
TOGETIC.Pokedex: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

BLISSEY.Name: Blissey
BLISSEY.Pokedex: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a Blissey will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.

XATU.Name: Xatu
XATU.Pokedex: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

FLYGON.Name: Flygon
FLYGON.Pokedex: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

MAREEP.Name: Mareep
MAREEP.Pokedex: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

FLAAFFY.Name: Flaaffy
FLAAFFY.Pokedex: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

MARILL.Name: Marill
MARILL.Pokedex: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.

AZUMARILL.Name: Azumarill
AZUMARILL.Pokedex: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

SUDOWOODO.Name: Sudowoodo
SUDOWOODO.Pokedex: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

POLITOED.Name: Politoed
POLITOED.Pokedex: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

HOPPIP.Name: Hoppip
HOPPIP.Pokedex: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

SKIPLOOM.Name: Skiploom
SKIPLOOM.Pokedex: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

JUMPLUFF.Name: Jumpluff
JUMPLUFF.Pokedex: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

AIPOM.Name: Aipom
AIPOM.Pokedex: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

AMBIPOM.Name: Ambipom
AMBIPOM.Pokedex: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

SUNFLORA.Name: Sunflora
SUNFLORA.Pokedex: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

ESPEON.Name: Espeon
ESPEON.Pokedex: An Espeon is extremely loyal to any trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its trainer from harm.

VOLCARONA.Name: Volcarona
VOLCARONA.Pokedex: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

YANMA.Name: Yanma
YANMA.Pokedex: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

WOOPER.Name: Wooper
WOOPER.Pokedex: Wooper usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

WOOPER,1.Name: Wooper
WOOPER,1.Pokedex: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

QUAGSIRE.Name: Quagsire
QUAGSIRE.Pokedex: A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

UMBREON.Name: Umbreon
UMBREON.Pokedex: Umbreon evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

MURKROW.Name: Murkrow
MURKROW.Pokedex: Murkrow were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.

SABLEYE.Name: Sableye
SABLEYE.Pokedex: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

DARKRAI.Name: Darkrai
DARKRAI.Pokedex: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

SABLEYE,1.Name: Sableye
SABLEYE,1.Pokedex: Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.

DARKRAI,1.Name: Darkrai
DARKRAI,1.Pokedex: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

SLOWKING.Name: Slowking
SLOWKING.Pokedex: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the Shellder on its head comes off.

SLOWKING,1.Name: Slowking
SLOWKING,1.Pokedex: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

PYROAR.Name: Pyroar
PYROAR.Pokedex: With fiery breath of more than 6,000 degrees Celsius, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

PYROAR,1.Name: Pyroar
PYROAR,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

MISDREAVUS.Name: Misdreavus
MISDREAVUS.Pokedex: A Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.

UNOWN.Name: Unown
UNOWN.Pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

UNOWN,1.Name: Unown
