WOBBUFFET.Name: Wobbuffet
WOBBUFFET.Pokedex: Usually docile, a Wobbuffet strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.

GIRAFARIG.Name: Girafarig
GIRAFARIG.Pokedex: A Girafarig is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.

PINECO.Name: Pineco
PINECO.Pokedex: A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and explodes.

FORRETRESS.Name: Forretress
FORRETRESS.Pokedex: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

BURMY.Name: Burmy
BURMY.Pokedex: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

WORMADAM.Name: Wormadam
WORMADAM.Pokedex: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

BURMY,1.Name: Burmy
BURMY,1.Pokedex: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

BURMY,2.Name: Burmy
BURMY,2.Pokedex: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

WORMADAM,1.Name: Wormadam
WORMADAM,1.Pokedex: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

WORMADAM,2.Name: Wormadam
WORMADAM,2.Pokedex: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

DUNSPARCE.Name: Dunsparce
DUNSPARCE.Pokedex: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

GLIGAR.Name: Gligar
GLIGAR.Pokedex: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.

STEELIX.Name: Steelix
STEELIX.Pokedex: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

STEELIX,1.Name: Steelix
STEELIX,1.Pokedex: It absorbs toxins from the food it eats. The distinct purple spikes on its body are evidence of its potent poison.

SHUCKLE.Name: Shuckle
SHUCKLE.Pokedex: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

HERACROSS.Name: Heracross
HERACROSS.Pokedex: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

HERACROSS,1.Name: Heracross
HERACROSS,1.Pokedex: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

SNEASEL.Name: Sneasel
SNEASEL.Pokedex: A Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

SNEASEL,1.Name: Sneasel
SNEASEL,1.Pokedex: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

WEAVILE.Name: Weavile
WEAVILE.Pokedex: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

TEDDIURSA.Name: Teddiursa
TEDDIURSA.Pokedex: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

URSARING.Name: Ursaring
URSARING.Pokedex: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an Ursaring gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

SLUGMA.Name: Slugma
SLUGMA.Pokedex: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

MAGCARGO.Name: Magcargo
MAGCARGO.Pokedex: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned Magcargo's bodies into magma.

SWINUB.Name: Swinub
SWINUB.Pokedex: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

PILOSWINE.Name: Piloswine
PILOSWINE.Pokedex: A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

CORSOLA.Name: Corsola
CORSOLA.Pokedex: Corsola live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

CORSOLA,1.Name: Corsola
CORSOLA,1.Pokedex: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

CURSOLA.Name: Cursola
CURSOLA.Pokedex: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

REMORAID.Name: Remoraid
REMORAID.Pokedex: A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.

OCTILLERY.Name: Octillery
OCTILLERY.Pokedex: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.

DELIBIRD.Name: Delibird
DELIBIRD.Pokedex: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a Delibird sharing its food.

MANTINE.Name: Mantine
MANTINE.Pokedex: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

MANTYKE.Name: Mantyke
MANTYKE.Pokedex: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

SKARMORY.Name: Skarmory
SKARMORY.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from Skarmory to make swords and knives.

SKARMORY,1.Name: Skarmory
SKARMORY,1.Pokedex: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.

HOUNDOUR.Name: Houndour
HOUNDOUR.Pokedex: Houndour communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.

HOUNDOOM.Name: Houndoom
HOUNDOOM.Pokedex: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

HOUNDOOM,1.Name: Houndoom
HOUNDOOM,1.Pokedex: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

PHANPY.Name: Phanpy
PHANPY.Pokedex: Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

DONPHAN.Name: Donphan
DONPHAN.Pokedex: A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

TYRANITAR.Name: Tyranitar
TYRANITAR.Pokedex: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

TYRANITAR,1.Name: Tyranitar
TYRANITAR,1.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

STANTLER.Name: Stantler
STANTLER.Pokedex: Stantler's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction.

SMEARGLE.Name: Smeargle
SMEARGLE.Pokedex: A Smeargle marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

TYROGUE.Name: Tyrogue
TYROGUE.Pokedex: Tyrogue become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the trainer must establish a regular training schedule.

HITMONTOP.Name: Hitmontop
HITMONTOP.Pokedex: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. Hitmontop travel faster spinning than they do walking.

SMOOCHUM.Name: Smoochum
SMOOCHUM.Pokedex: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

MAGBY.Name: Magby
MAGBY.Pokedex: If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

MILTANK.Name: Miltank
MILTANK.Pokedex: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and adults alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

RAIKOU.Name: Raikou
RAIKOU.Pokedex: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.

SUICUNE.Name: Suicune
SUICUNE.Pokedex: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.

LARVITAR.Name: Larvitar
LARVITAR.Pokedex: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

PUPITAR.Name: Pupitar
PUPITAR.Pokedex: A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.

LUGIA.Name: Lugia
LUGIA.Pokedex: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

HOOH.Name: Ho-Oh
HOOH.Pokedex: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which light strikes them--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

CELEBI.Name: Celebi
CELEBI.Pokedex: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

TREECKO.Name: Treecko
TREECKO.Pokedex: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the trees.

GROVYLE.Name: Grovyle
GROVYLE.Pokedex: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

SCEPTILE.Name: Sceptile
SCEPTILE.Pokedex: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

SCEPTILE,1.Name: Sceptile
SCEPTILE,1.Pokedex: The seeds on its back are filled with energy from Mega Evolution. The Pokémon detonates these seeds to launch the tip of its tail.

TORCHIC.Name: Torchic
TORCHIC.Pokedex: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

COMBUSKEN.Name: Combusken
COMBUSKEN.Pokedex: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

BLAZIKEN.Name: Blaziken
BLAZIKEN.Pokedex: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

BLAZIKEN,1.Name: Blaziken
BLAZIKEN,1.Pokedex: Boiling-hot blood courses through its entire body, doubling the sharpness of its moves. It subdues opponents in the blink of an eye.

MUDKIP.Name: Mudkip
MUDKIP.Pokedex: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

MARSHTOMP.Name: Marshtomp
MARSHTOMP.Pokedex: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

SWAMPERT.Name: Swampert
SWAMPERT.Pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

SWAMPERT,1.Name: Swampert
SWAMPERT,1.Pokedex: The water within its body further strengthens its already enlarged muscles, using the same principles as a hydraulic pump.

POOCHYENA.Name: Poochyena
POOCHYENA.Pokedex: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

MIGHTYENA.Name: Mightyena
MIGHTYENA.Pokedex: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

DREDNAW.Name: Drednaw
DREDNAW.Pokedex: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

ZIGZAGOON.Name: Zigzagoon
ZIGZAGOON.Pokedex: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

ZIGZAGOON,1.Name: Zigzagoon
ZIGZAGOON,1.Pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

LINOONE.Name: Linoone
LINOONE.Pokedex: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

LINOONE,1.Name: Linoone
LINOONE,1.Pokedex: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

LOTAD.Name: Lotad
LOTAD.Pokedex: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

LOMBRE.Name: Lombre
LOMBRE.Pokedex: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

LUDICOLO.Name: Ludicolo
LUDICOLO.Pokedex: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

SEEDOT.Name: Seedot
SEEDOT.Pokedex: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

NUZLEAF.Name: Nuzleaf
NUZLEAF.Pokedex: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

IMPIDIMP.Name: Impidimp
IMPIDIMP.Pokedex: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

SHIFTRY.Name: Shiftry
SHIFTRY.Pokedex: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

TAILLOW.Name: Taillow
TAILLOW.Pokedex: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

SWELLOW.Name: Swellow
SWELLOW.Pokedex: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

WINGULL.Name: Wingull
WINGULL.Pokedex: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

PELIPPER.Name: Pelipper
PELIPPER.Pokedex: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

DUCKLETT.Name: Ducklett
DUCKLETT.Pokedex: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

RALTS.Name: Ralts
RALTS.Pokedex: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

KIRLIA.Name: Kirlia
KIRLIA.Pokedex: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

MESPRIT.Name: Mesprit
MESPRIT.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

INDEEDEE.Name: Indeedee
INDEEDEE.Pokedex: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

INDEEDEE,1.Name: Indeedee
INDEEDEE,1.Pokedex: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

GARDEVOIR.Name: Gardevoir
GARDEVOIR.Pokedex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its trainer.

GARDEVOIR,1.Name: Gardevoir
GARDEVOIR,1.Pokedex: When it opens the red plate on its chest and unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power is released.

SURSKIT.Name: Surskit
SURSKIT.Pokedex: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

MASQUERAIN.Name: Masquerain
MASQUERAIN.Pokedex: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters from rain under large trees and eaves.

SLAKOTH.Name: Slakoth
SLAKOTH.Pokedex: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

VIGOROTH.Name: Vigoroth
VIGOROTH.Pokedex: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

SLAKING.Name: Slaking
SLAKING.Pokedex: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

NINCADA.Name: Nincada
NINCADA.Pokedex: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

NINJASK.Name: Ninjask
NINJASK.Pokedex: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

GRENINJA.Name: Greninja
GRENINJA.Pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

GRENINJA,1.Name: Greninja
GRENINJA,1.Pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

GRENINJA,2.Name: Greninja
GRENINJA,2.Pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

GRENINJA,3.Name: Greninja
GRENINJA,3.Pokedex: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

SHEDINJA.Name: Shedinja
SHEDINJA.Pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

WHISMUR.Name: Whismur
WHISMUR.Pokedex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

LOUDRED.Name: Loudred
LOUDRED.Pokedex: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

EXPLOUD.Name: Exploud
EXPLOUD.Pokedex: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

MAKUHITA.Name: Makuhita
MAKUHITA.Pokedex: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

HARIYAMA.Name: Hariyama
HARIYAMA.Pokedex: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

AZURILL.Name: Azurill
AZURILL.Pokedex: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

NOSEPASS.Name: Nosepass
NOSEPASS.Pokedex: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

PROBOPASS.Name: Probopass
PROBOPASS.Pokedex: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

SKITTY.Name: Skitty
SKITTY.Pokedex: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

DELCATTY.Name: Delcatty
DELCATTY.Pokedex: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

MAWILE.Name: Mawile
MAWILE.Pokedex: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

MAWILE,1.Name: Mawile
MAWILE,1.Pokedex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

ARON.Name: Aron
ARON.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

LAIRON.Name: Lairon
LAIRON.Pokedex: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

AGGRON.Name: Aggron
AGGRON.Pokedex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

AGGRON,1.Name: Aggron
AGGRON,1.Pokedex: Energy from Mega Evolution has turned the iron inside this Pokémon into steel armor that covers Mega Aggron's whole body.

MEDITITE.Name: Meditite
MEDITITE.Pokedex: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

MEDICHAM.Name: Medicham
MEDICHAM.Pokedex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

MEDICHAM,1.Name: Medicham
MEDICHAM,1.Pokedex: Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice to defeat its enemies.

ELECTRIKE.Name: Electrike
ELECTRIKE.Pokedex: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

MANECTRIC.Name: Manectric
MANECTRIC.Pokedex: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

MANECTRIC,1.Name: Manectric
MANECTRIC,1.Pokedex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

PLUSLE.Name: Plusle
PLUSLE.Pokedex: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

MINUN.Name: Minun
MINUN.Pokedex: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

VOLBEAT.Name: Volbeat
VOLBEAT.Pokedex: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

ILLUMISE.Name: Illumise
ILLUMISE.Pokedex: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been seen.

ROSELIA.Name: Roselia
ROSELIA.Pokedex: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

GULPIN.Name: Gulpin
GULPIN.Pokedex: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

SWALOT.Name: Swalot
SWALOT.Pokedex: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

CARVANHA.Name: Carvanha
CARVANHA.Pokedex: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

SHARPEDO.Name: Sharpedo
SHARPEDO.Pokedex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

SHARPEDO,1.Name: Sharpedo
SHARPEDO,1.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

HYDREIGON.Name: Hydreigon
HYDREIGON.Pokedex: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

WAILMER.Name: Wailmer
WAILMER.Pokedex: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

WAILORD.Name: Wailord
WAILORD.Pokedex: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

NUMEL.Name: Numel
NUMEL.Pokedex: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

CAMERUPT.Name: Camerupt
CAMERUPT.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

CAMERUPT,1.Name: Camerupt
CAMERUPT,1.Pokedex: When this Pokémon's rage reaches a boiling point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back erupts violently, spewing molten lava.

TORKOAL.Name: Torkoal
TORKOAL.Pokedex: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

ROLYCOLY.Name: Rolycoly
ROLYCOLY.Pokedex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

CARKOL.Name: Carkol
CARKOL.Pokedex: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,000 degrees Celsius.

COALOSSAL.Name: Coalossal
COALOSSAL.Pokedex: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

SPOINK.Name: Spoink
SPOINK.Pokedex: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

GRUMPIG.Name: Grumpig
GRUMPIG.Pokedex: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

GOTHORITA.Name: Gothorita
GOTHORITA.Pokedex: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

SPINDA.Name: Spinda
SPINDA.Pokedex: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

TRAPINCH.Name: Trapinch
TRAPINCH.Pokedex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

VIBRAVA.Name: Vibrava
VIBRAVA.Pokedex: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

PALPITOAD.Name: Palpitoad
PALPITOAD.Pokedex: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

SEISMITOAD.Name: Seismitoad
SEISMITOAD.Pokedex: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

CACNEA.Name: Cacnea
CACNEA.Pokedex: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

MARACTUS.Name: Maractus
MARACTUS.Pokedex: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

CACTURNE.Name: Cacturne
CACTURNE.Pokedex: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

SWABLU.Name: Swablu
SWABLU.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

ALTARIA.Name: Altaria
ALTARIA.Pokedex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

ALTARIA,1.Name: Altaria
ALTARIA,1.Pokedex: Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could melt it. But it's strong enough that just a few strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.

ZANGOOSE.Name: Zangoose
ZANGOOSE.Pokedex: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

SEVIPER.Name: Seviper
SEVIPER.Pokedex: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

LUNATONE.Name: Lunatone
LUNATONE.Pokedex: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

SOLROCK.Name: Solrock
SOLROCK.Pokedex: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

BARBOACH.Name: Barboach
BARBOACH.Pokedex: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

WHISCASH.Name: Whiscash
WHISCASH.Pokedex: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

CORPHISH.Name: Corphish
CORPHISH.Pokedex: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

CRAWDAUNT.Name: Crawdaunt
CRAWDAUNT.Pokedex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

BALTOY.Name: Baltoy
BALTOY.Pokedex: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

CLAYDOL.Name: Claydol
CLAYDOL.Pokedex: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

LILEEP.Name: Lileep
LILEEP.Pokedex: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

CRADILY.Name: Cradily
CRADILY.Pokedex: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

ANORITH.Name: Anorith
ANORITH.Pokedex: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

ARMALDO.Name: Armaldo
ARMALDO.Pokedex: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

MILOTIC.Name: Milotic
MILOTIC.Pokedex: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

CASTFORM.Name: Castform
CASTFORM.Pokedex: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

CASTFORM,1.Name: Castform
CASTFORM,1.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes on the brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot to the touch, so approach with care.

CASTFORM,2.Name: Castform
CASTFORM,2.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

CASTFORM,3.Name: Castform
CASTFORM,3.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when covered in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material, with a temperature near -5 degrees Celsius.

DEOXYS.Name: Deoxys
DEOXYS.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

ROTOM.Name: Rotom
ROTOM.Pokedex: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

GENESECT.Name: Genesect
GENESECT.Pokedex: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

TERAPAGOS.Name: Terapagos
TERAPAGOS.Pokedex: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

KECLEON.Name: Kecleon
KECLEON.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

SHUPPET.Name: Shuppet
SHUPPET.Pokedex: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

BANETTE.Name: Banette
BANETTE.Pokedex: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

BANETTE,1.Name: Banette
BANETTE,1.Pokedex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

DUSKULL.Name: Duskull
DUSKULL.Pokedex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

DUSCLOPS.Name: Dusclops
DUSCLOPS.Pokedex: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

TROPIUS.Name: Tropius
TROPIUS.Pokedex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

BOUNSWEET.Name: Bounsweet
BOUNSWEET.Pokedex: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

STEENEE.Name: Steenee
STEENEE.Pokedex: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

TSAREENA.Name: Tsareena
TSAREENA.Pokedex: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.

CHIMECHO.Name: Chimecho
CHIMECHO.Pokedex: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

CHIMECHO,1.Name: Chimecho
CHIMECHO,1.Pokedex: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

ABSOL.Name: Absol
ABSOL.Pokedex: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

ABSOL,1.Name: Absol
ABSOL,1.Pokedex: When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

ABSOL,2.Name: Absol
ABSOL,2.Pokedex: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

WYNAUT.Name: Wynaut
WYNAUT.Pokedex: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.

SNORUNT.Name: Snorunt
SNORUNT.Pokedex: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

GLALIE.Name: Glalie
GLALIE.Pokedex: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

GLALIE,1.Name: Glalie
GLALIE,1.Pokedex: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

SPHEAL.Name: Spheal
SPHEAL.Pokedex: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

SEALEO.Name: Sealeo
SEALEO.Pokedex: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

WALREIN.Name: Walrein
WALREIN.Pokedex: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

HUNTAIL.Name: Huntail
HUNTAIL.Pokedex: To withstand the crushing water pressure deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

GOREBYSS.Name: Gorebyss
GOREBYSS.Pokedex: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

RELICANTH.Name: Relicanth
RELICANTH.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was once believed to be extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

LUVDISC.Name: Luvdisc
LUVDISC.Pokedex: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.

BAGON.Name: Bagon
BAGON.Pokedex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

SHELGON.Name: Shelgon
SHELGON.Pokedex: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

BELDUM.Name: Beldum
BELDUM.Pokedex: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

METANG.Name: Metang
METANG.Pokedex: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

METAGROSS.Name: Metagross
METAGROSS.Pokedex: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

METAGROSS,1.Name: Metagross
METAGROSS,1.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

REGIROCK.Name: Regirock
REGIROCK.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.

REGICE.Name: Regice
REGICE.Pokedex: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.

AVALUGG.Name: Avalugg
AVALUGG.Pokedex: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

AVALUGG,1.Name: Avalugg
AVALUGG,1.Pokedex: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

REGISTEEL.Name: Registeel
REGISTEEL.Pokedex: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

LATIAS.Name: Latias
LATIAS.Pokedex: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

LATIAS,1.Name: Latias
LATIAS,1.Pokedex: Both its flying capabilities and its attack power have increased. It scatters transparent down to confuse its enemies.

LATIOS.Name: Latios
LATIOS.Pokedex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

LATIOS,1.Name: Latios
LATIOS,1.Pokedex: It flies at speeds exceeding Mach 4. It is among the top tier of all Pokémon in terms of aerial combat capability.

KYOGRE.Name: Kyogre
KYOGRE.Pokedex: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

KYOGRE,1.Name: Kyogre
KYOGRE,1.Pokedex: Kyogre reverted to this state via the Blue Orb, which contains the energy of the primordial world. Kyogre's body resembles seawater.

GROUDON.Name: Groudon
GROUDON.Pokedex: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

GROUDON,1.Name: Groudon
GROUDON,1.Pokedex: This is Groudon's true form, restored using the Red Orb. Energy spills from its body in the form of magma.

TORTERRA.Name: Torterra
TORTERRA.Pokedex: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

RAYQUAZA.Name: Rayquaza
RAYQUAZA.Pokedex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

RAYQUAZA,1.Name: Rayquaza
RAYQUAZA,1.Pokedex: A shooting star streaking across the night sky may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully after a meteoroid.

JIRACHI.Name: Jirachi
JIRACHI.Pokedex: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.

DEOXYS,1.Name: Deoxys
DEOXYS,1.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

DEOXYS,2.Name: Deoxys
DEOXYS,2.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

DEOXYS,3.Name: Deoxys
DEOXYS,3.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

TURTWIG.Name: Turtwig
TURTWIG.Pokedex: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

GROTLE.Name: Grotle
GROTLE.Pokedex: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

CHIMCHAR.Name: Chimchar
CHIMCHAR.Pokedex: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

GROOKEY.Name: Grookey
GROOKEY.Pokedex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

MONFERNO.Name: Monferno
MONFERNO.Pokedex: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

PANCHAM.Name: Pancham
PANCHAM.Pokedex: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

PIPLUP.Name: Piplup
PIPLUP.Pokedex: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

PRINPLUP.Name: Prinplup
PRINPLUP.Pokedex: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

EISCUE.Name: Eiscue
EISCUE.Pokedex: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

EISCUE,1.Name: Eiscue
EISCUE,1.Pokedex: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

EMPOLEON.Name: Empoleon
EMPOLEON.Pokedex: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

CALYREX,1.Name: Calyrex
CALYREX,1.Pokedex: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

CALYREX,2.Name: Calyrex
CALYREX,2.Pokedex: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

STARLY.Name: Starly
STARLY.Pokedex: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

STARAVIA.Name: Staravia
STARAVIA.Pokedex: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

STARAPTOR.Name: Staraptor
STARAPTOR.Pokedex: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

STARAPTOR,1.Name: Staraptor
STARAPTOR,1.Pokedex: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

BIDOOF.Name: Bidoof
BIDOOF.Pokedex: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

BIBAREL.Name: Bibarel
BIBAREL.Pokedex: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

KRICKETOT.Name: Kricketot
KRICKETOT.Pokedex: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

KRICKETUNE.Name: Kricketune
KRICKETUNE.Pokedex: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

SHINX.Name: Shinx
SHINX.Pokedex: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

LUXIO.Name: Luxio
LUXIO.Pokedex: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

LUXRAY.Name: Luxray
LUXRAY.Pokedex: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

BUDEW.Name: Budew
BUDEW.Pokedex: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

ROSERADE.Name: Roserade
ROSERADE.Pokedex: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

CRANIDOS.Name: Cranidos
CRANIDOS.Pokedex: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

RAMPARDOS.Name: Rampardos
RAMPARDOS.Pokedex: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

SHIELDON.Name: Shieldon
SHIELDON.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

BASTIODON.Name: Bastiodon
BASTIODON.Pokedex: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

MOTHIM.Name: Mothim
MOTHIM.Pokedex: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

COMBEE.Name: Combee
COMBEE.Pokedex: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.

VESPIQUEN.Name: Vespiquen
VESPIQUEN.Pokedex: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

PACHIRISU.Name: Pachirisu
PACHIRISU.Pokedex: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

BUIZEL.Name: Buizel
BUIZEL.Pokedex: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

FLOATZEL.Name: Floatzel
FLOATZEL.Pokedex: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

CHERUBI.Name: Cherubi
CHERUBI.Pokedex: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

CHERRIM.Name: Cherrim
CHERRIM.Pokedex: Its folded petals are pretty tough. Bird Pokémon can peck at them all they want, and Cherrim won't be bothered at all.

CHERRIM,1.Name: Cherrim
CHERRIM,1.Pokedex: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

SHELLOS.Name: Shellos
SHELLOS.Pokedex: This Pokémon's habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.

SHELLOS,1.Name: Shellos
SHELLOS,1.Pokedex: Its appearance changes depending on the environment. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

GASTRODON.Name: Gastrodon
GASTRODON.Pokedex: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

GASTRODON,1.Name: Gastrodon
GASTRODON,1.Pokedex: Its body is covered in a sticky slime. It's very susceptible to dehydration, so it can't spend too much time on land.

DRIFBLIM.Name: Drifblim
DRIFBLIM.Pokedex: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

BUNEARY.Name: Buneary
BUNEARY.Pokedex: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

LOPUNNY.Name: Lopunny
LOPUNNY.Pokedex: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

SCORBUNNY.Name: Scorbunny
SCORBUNNY.Pokedex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

RABOOT.Name: Raboot
RABOOT.Pokedex: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

LOPUNNY,1.Name: Lopunny
LOPUNNY,1.Pokedex: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

MISMAGIUS.Name: Mismagius
MISMAGIUS.Pokedex: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

HONCHKROW.Name: Honchkrow
HONCHKROW.Pokedex: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.

GLAMEOW.Name: Glameow
GLAMEOW.Pokedex: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

PURUGLY.Name: Purugly
PURUGLY.Pokedex: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

CHINGLING.Name: Chingling
CHINGLING.Pokedex: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

STUNKY.Name: Stunky
STUNKY.Pokedex: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

SKUNTANK.Name: Skuntank
SKUNTANK.Pokedex: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

BRONZOR.Name: Bronzor
BRONZOR.Pokedex: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

BRONZONG.Name: Bronzong
BRONZONG.Pokedex: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

BONSLY.Name: Bonsly
BONSLY.Pokedex: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

MIMEJR.Name: Mime Jr.
MIMEJR.Pokedex: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

HAPPINY.Name: Happiny
HAPPINY.Pokedex: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

CHATOT.Name: Chatot
CHATOT.Pokedex: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

SPIRITOMB.Name: Spiritomb
SPIRITOMB.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

GIBLE.Name: Gible
GIBLE.Pokedex: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

GABITE.Name: Gabite
GABITE.Pokedex: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

DRUDDIGON.Name: Druddigon
DRUDDIGON.Pokedex: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. Then skin on its face is harder than a rock.

GARCHOMP.Name: Garchomp
GARCHOMP.Pokedex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

GARCHOMP,1.Name: Garchomp
GARCHOMP,1.Pokedex: Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

GARCHOMP,2.Name: Garchomp
GARCHOMP,2.Pokedex: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

MUNCHLAX.Name: Munchlax
MUNCHLAX.Pokedex: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

RIOLU.Name: Riolu
RIOLU.Pokedex: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

LUCARIO.Name: Lucario
LUCARIO.Pokedex: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

LUCARIO,1.Name: Lucario
LUCARIO,1.Pokedex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

LUCARIO,2.Name: Lucario
LUCARIO,2.Pokedex: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

HIPPOPOTAS.Name: Hippopotas
HIPPOPOTAS.Pokedex: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

HIPPOWDON.Name: Hippowdon
HIPPOWDON.Pokedex: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

SKORUPI.Name: Skorupi
SKORUPI.Pokedex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

DRAPION.Name: Drapion
DRAPION.Pokedex: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

CROAGUNK.Name: Croagunk
CROAGUNK.Pokedex: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

TOXICROAK.Name: Toxicroak
TOXICROAK.Pokedex: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

CARNIVINE.Name: Carnivine
CARNIVINE.Pokedex: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

FINNEON.Name: Finneon
FINNEON.Pokedex: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

LUMINEON.Name: Lumineon
LUMINEON.Pokedex: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

SNOVER.Name: Snover
SNOVER.Pokedex: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

ABOMASNOW.Name: Abomasnow
ABOMASNOW.Pokedex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

ABOMASNOW,1.Name: Abomasnow
ABOMASNOW,1.Pokedex: The buds on its back have sprouted into impressive icicles that can whip up massive blizzards of −22 degrees Fahrenheit.

MAGNEZONE.Name: Magnezone
MAGNEZONE.Pokedex: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

ELECTIVIRE.Name: Electivire
ELECTIVIRE.Pokedex: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

ZEBSTRIKA.Name: Zebstrika
ZEBSTRIKA.Pokedex: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

MAGMORTAR.Name: Magmortar
MAGMORTAR.Pokedex: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

TOGEKISS.Name: Togekiss
TOGEKISS.Pokedex: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

YANMEGA.Name: Yanmega
YANMEGA.Pokedex: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

LEAFEON.Name: Leafeon
LEAFEON.Pokedex: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

GLACEON.Name: Glaceon
GLACEON.Pokedex: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

VANILLITE.Name: Vanillite
VANILLITE.Pokedex: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

GLISCOR.Name: Gliscor
GLISCOR.Pokedex: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

MAMOSWINE.Name: Mamoswine
MAMOSWINE.Pokedex: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

GALLADE.Name: Gallade
GALLADE.Pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

GALLADE,1.Name: Gallade
GALLADE,1.Pokedex: It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer. Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its enemies and a cape to protect its body.

DUSKNOIR.Name: Dusknoir
DUSKNOIR.Pokedex: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

FROSLASS.Name: Froslass
FROSLASS.Pokedex: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

FROSLASS,1.Name: Froslass
FROSLASS,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

ROTOM,1.Name: Rotom
ROTOM,1.Pokedex: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

ROTOM,2.Name: Rotom
ROTOM,2.Pokedex: This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

ROTOM,3.Name: Rotom
ROTOM,3.Pokedex: Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a refrigerator powered by a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

ROTOM,4.Name: Rotom
ROTOM,4.Pokedex: In this form, Rotom applies its new power over wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

ROTOM,5.Name: Rotom
ROTOM,5.Pokedex: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower that has a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

UXIE.Name: Uxie
UXIE.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

AZELF.Name: Azelf
AZELF.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

DIALGA.Name: Dialga
DIALGA.Pokedex: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

DIALGA,1.Name: Dialga
DIALGA,1.Pokedex: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

PALKIA.Name: Palkia
PALKIA.Pokedex: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

PALKIA,1.Name: Palkia
PALKIA,1.Pokedex: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia's strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

HEATRAN.Name: Heatran
HEATRAN.Pokedex: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

HEATRAN,1.Name: Heatran
HEATRAN,1.Pokedex: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

REGIGIGAS.Name: Regigigas
REGIGIGAS.Pokedex: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

GIRATINA.Name: Giratina
GIRATINA.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

GIRATINA,1.Name: Giratina
GIRATINA,1.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

CRESSELIA.Name: Cresselia
CRESSELIA.Pokedex: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

PHIONE.Name: Phione
PHIONE.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

MANAPHY.Name: Manaphy
MANAPHY.Pokedex: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

SHAYMIN.Name: Shaymin
SHAYMIN.Pokedex: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

SHAYMIN,1.Name: Shaymin
SHAYMIN,1.Pokedex: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

ARCEUS.Name: Arceus
ARCEUS.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

ARCEUS,1.Name: Arceus
ARCEUS,1.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

ARCEUS,18.Name: Arceus
ARCEUS,18.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

SILVALLY.Name: Silvally
SILVALLY.Pokedex: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

VICTINI.Name: Victini
VICTINI.Pokedex: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

SNIVY.Name: Snivy
SNIVY.Pokedex: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

SERVINE.Name: Servine
SERVINE.Pokedex: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

SERPERIOR.Name: Serperior
SERPERIOR.Pokedex: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents, but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

TEPIG.Name: Tepig
TEPIG.Pokedex: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

PIGNITE.Name: Pignite
PIGNITE.Pokedex: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

EMBOAR.Name: Emboar
EMBOAR.Pokedex: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

EMBOAR,1.Name: Emboar
EMBOAR,1.Pokedex: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.

OSHAWOTT.Name: Oshawott
OSHAWOTT.Pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

OSHAWOTT,1.Name: Oshawott
OSHAWOTT,1.Pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

DEWOTT.Name: Dewott
DEWOTT.Pokedex: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

DEWOTT,1.Name: Dewott
DEWOTT,1.Pokedex: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

SAMUROTT.Name: Samurott
SAMUROTT.Pokedex: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

SAMUROTT,1.Name: Samurott
SAMUROTT,1.Pokedex: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

WATCHOG.Name: Watchog
WATCHOG.Pokedex: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

HERDIER.Name: Herdier
HERDIER.Pokedex: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

STOUTLAND.Name: Stoutland
STOUTLAND.Pokedex: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

PURRLOIN.Name: Purrloin
PURRLOIN.Pokedex: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

MORGREM.Name: Morgrem
MORGREM.Pokedex: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

LIEPARD.Name: Liepard
LIEPARD.Pokedex: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

PANSAGE.Name: Pansage
PANSAGE.Pokedex: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

SIMISAGE.Name: Simisage
SIMISAGE.Pokedex: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

PANSEAR.Name: Pansear
PANSEAR.Pokedex: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

SIMISEAR.Name: Simisear
SIMISEAR.Pokedex: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

FLETCHINDER.Name: Fletchinder
FLETCHINDER.Pokedex: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

PANPOUR.Name: Panpour
PANPOUR.Pokedex: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

SIMIPOUR.Name: Simipour
SIMIPOUR.Pokedex: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

MUNNA.Name: Munna
MUNNA.Pokedex: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dreams, it expels pink-colored mist.

MUSHARNA.Name: Musharna
MUSHARNA.Pokedex: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

PIDOVE.Name: Pidove
PIDOVE.Pokedex: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

TRANQUILL.Name: Tranquill
TRANQUILL.Pokedex: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

UNFEZANT.Name: Unfezant
UNFEZANT.Pokedex: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

BLITZLE.Name: Blitzle
BLITZLE.Pokedex: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

ROGGENROLA.Name: Roggenrola
ROGGENROLA.Pokedex: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

BOLDORE.Name: Boldore
BOLDORE.Pokedex: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

GLIMMET.Name: Glimmet
GLIMMET.Pokedex: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

GLIMMORA.Name: Glimmora
GLIMMORA.Pokedex: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

GLIMMORA,1.Name: Glimmora
GLIMMORA,1.Pokedex: Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

GIGALITH.Name: Gigalith
GIGALITH.Pokedex: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

SWOOBAT.Name: Swoobat
SWOOBAT.Pokedex: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

EXCADRILL.Name: Excadrill
EXCADRILL.Pokedex: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

EXCADRILL,1.Name: Excadrill
EXCADRILL,1.Pokedex: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

AUDINO.Name: Audino
AUDINO.Pokedex: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

AUDINO,1.Name: Audino
AUDINO,1.Pokedex: Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall into a deep sleep.

TIMBURR.Name: Timburr
TIMBURR.Pokedex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

GURDURR.Name: Gurdurr
GURDURR.Pokedex: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

CONKELDURR.Name: Conkeldurr
CONKELDURR.Pokedex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

THROH.Name: Throh
THROH.Pokedex: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

SAWK.Name: Sawk
SAWK.Pokedex: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

SEWADDLE.Name: Sewaddle
SEWADDLE.Pokedex: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

SWADLOON.Name: Swadloon
SWADLOON.Pokedex: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

LEAVANNY.Name: Leavanny
LEAVANNY.Pokedex: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

DRAKLOAK.Name: Drakloak
DRAKLOAK.Pokedex: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

VENIPEDE.Name: Venipede
VENIPEDE.Pokedex: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.

WHIRLIPEDE.Name: Whirlipede
WHIRLIPEDE.Pokedex: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

SCOLIPEDE.Name: Scolipede
SCOLIPEDE.Pokedex: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

SCOLIPEDE,1.Name: Scolipede
SCOLIPEDE,1.Pokedex: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

COTTONEE.Name: Cottonee
COTTONEE.Pokedex: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

WHIMSICOTT.Name: Whimsicott
WHIMSICOTT.Pokedex: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

PETILIL.Name: Petilil
PETILIL.Pokedex: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

PETILIL,1.Name: Petilil
PETILIL,1.Pokedex: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

LILLIGANT.Name: Lilligant
LILLIGANT.Pokedex: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

LILLIGANT,1.Name: Lilligant
LILLIGANT,1.Pokedex: They suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

GOSSIFLEUR.Name: Gossifleur
GOSSIFLEUR.Pokedex: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

BASCULIN.Name: Basculin
BASCULIN.Pokedex: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

BASCULIN,2.Name: Basculin
BASCULIN,2.Pokedex: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—people have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

BASCULIN,3.Name: Basculin
BASCULIN,3.Pokedex: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

SANDILE.Name: Sandile
SANDILE.Pokedex: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

KROKOROK.Name: Krokorok
KROKOROK.Pokedex: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings, even in darkness.

KROOKODILE.Name: Krookodile
KROOKODILE.Pokedex: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

DARUMAKA.Name: Darumaka
DARUMAKA.Pokedex: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

DARUMAKA,2.Name: Darumaka
DARUMAKA,2.Pokedex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

DARMANITAN,2.Name: Darmanitan
DARMANITAN,2.Pokedex: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

DARMANITAN,3.Name: Darmanitan
DARMANITAN,3.Pokedex: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

DARMANITAN.Name: Darmanitan
DARMANITAN.Pokedex: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

DARMANITAN,1.Name: Darmanitan
DARMANITAN,1.Pokedex: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

DWEBBLE.Name: Dwebble
DWEBBLE.Pokedex: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

CRUSTLE.Name: Crustle
CRUSTLE.Pokedex: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

SCRAGGY.Name: Scraggy
SCRAGGY.Pokedex: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

SCRAFTY.Name: Scrafty
SCRAFTY.Pokedex: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

SCRAFTY,1.Name: Scrafty
SCRAFTY,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

SIGILYPH.Name: Sigilyph
SIGILYPH.Pokedex: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

YAMASK.Name: Yamask
YAMASK.Pokedex: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

YAMASK,1.Name: Yamask
YAMASK,1.Pokedex: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

COFAGRIGUS.Name: Cofagrigus
COFAGRIGUS.Pokedex: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

TIRTOUGA.Name: Tirtouga
TIRTOUGA.Pokedex: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

CARRACOSTA.Name: Carracosta
CARRACOSTA.Pokedex: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

ARCHEN.Name: Archen
ARCHEN.Pokedex: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

ARCHEOPS.Name: Archeops
ARCHEOPS.Pokedex: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

TRUBBISH.Name: Trubbish
TRUBBISH.Pokedex: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that crated this Pokémon.

GARBODOR.Name: Garbodor
GARBODOR.Pokedex: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

ZORUA.Name: Zorua
ZORUA.Pokedex: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

ZORUA,1.Name: Zorua
ZORUA,1.Pokedex: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

ZOROARK.Name: Zoroark
ZOROARK.Pokedex: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

ZOROARK,1.Name: Zoroark
ZOROARK,1.Pokedex: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

MINCCINO.Name: Minccino
MINCCINO.Pokedex: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

CINCCINO.Name: Cinccino
CINCCINO.Pokedex: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

GOTHITA.Name: Gothita
GOTHITA.Pokedex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

GOTHITELLE.Name: Gothitelle
GOTHITELLE.Pokedex: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

SOLOSIS.Name: Solosis
SOLOSIS.Pokedex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

DUOSION.Name: Duosion
DUOSION.Pokedex: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

REUNICLUS.Name: Reuniclus
REUNICLUS.Pokedex: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

SWANNA.Name: Swanna
SWANNA.Pokedex: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

VANILLISH.Name: Vanillish
VANILLISH.Pokedex: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

VANILLUXE.Name: Vanilluxe
VANILLUXE.Pokedex: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

DEERLING.Name: Deerling
DEERLING.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

DEERLING,1.Name: Deerling
DEERLING,1.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

DEERLING,3.Name: Deerling
DEERLING,3.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

SAWSBUCK.Name: Sawsbuck
SAWSBUCK.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

SAWSBUCK,1.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
