FOCUSENERGY.Description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

FORESIGHT.Name: Foresight
FORESIGHT.Description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any kind of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

ODORSLEUTH.Description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
ODORSLEUTH.Name: Odor Sleuth

GLARE.Name: Glare
GLARE.Description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

GROWL.Name: Growl
GROWL.Description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The foe's Attack stat is lowered.

GROWTH.Name: Growth
GROWTH.Description: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.

HAPPYHOUR.Name: Happy Hour
HAPPYHOUR.Description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

HARDEN.Name: Harden
HARDEN.Description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

HEALBELL.Name: Heal Bell
HEALBELL.Description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

HELPINGHAND.Name: Helping Hand
HELPINGHAND.Description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

HOLDHANDS.Name: Hold Hands
HOLDHANDS.Description: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

HOWL.Name: Howl
HOWL.Description: The user howls loudly to raise the spirit of itself and allies, boosting their Attack stats.

LASERFOCUS.Name: Laser Focus
LASERFOCUS.Description: The user focuses intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

LOCKON.Name: Lock-On
LOCKON.Description: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

LOVELYKISS.Name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELYKISS.Description: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.

LUCKYCHANT.Name: Lucky Chant
LUCKYCHANT.Description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

MEFIRST.Name: Me First
MEFIRST.Description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe's intended move with greater power.

MEANLOOK.Name: Mean Look
MEANLOOK.Description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

MILKDRINK.Name: Milk Drink
MILKDRINK.Description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

MIMIC.Name: Mimic
MIMIC.Description: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used until the user is switched out.

MINDREADER.Name: Mind Reader
MINDREADER.Description: The user senses the foe's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the foe.

MINIMIZE.Name: Minimize
MINIMIZE.Description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

NATUREPOWER.Name: Nature Power
NATUREPOWER.Description: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

NOBLEROAR.Name: Noble Roar
NOBLEROAR.Description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.

PAINSPLIT.Name: Pain Split
PAINSPLIT.Description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

PERISHSONG.Name: Perish Song
PERISHSONG.Description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

PLAYNICE.Name: Play Nice
PLAYNICE.Description: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.

RECOVER.Name: Recover
RECOVER.Description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

REFLECTTYPE.Name: Reflect Type
REFLECTTYPE.Description: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.

REFRESH.Name: Refresh
REFRESH.Description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

SCARYFACE.Name: Scary Face
SCARYFACE.Description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

SHARPEN.Name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.Description: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

SHELLSMASH.Name: Shell Smash
SHELLSMASH.Description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.

SIMPLEBEAM.Name: Simple Beam
SIMPLEBEAM.Description: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

SING.Name: Sing
SING.Description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

SKETCH.Name: Sketch
SKETCH.Description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the foe. Once used, Sketch disappears.

SLACKOFF.Name: Slack Off
SLACKOFF.Description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

SMOKESCREEN.Name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.Description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

SOFTBOILED.Name: Soft-Boiled
SOFTBOILED.Description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

SPOTLIGHT.Name: Spotlight
SPOTLIGHT.Description: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only it will be attacked during the turn.

STOCKPILE.Name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.Description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

STUFFCHEEKS.Name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFFCHEEKS.Description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

SUPERSONIC.Name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.Description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

SWALLOW.Name: Swallow
SWALLOW.Description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

SWEETSCENT.Name: Sweet Scent
SWEETSCENT.Description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

TAILWHIP.Name: Tail Whip
TAILWHIP.Description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

TEARFULLOOK.Name: Tearful Look
TEARFULLOOK.Description: Gets teary eyed to make the target lose its will to fight. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

TEATIME.Name: Teatime
TEATIME.Description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

TEETERDANCE.Name: Teeter Dance
TEETERDANCE.Description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

TICKLE.Name: Tickle
TICKLE.Description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

WHIRLWIND.Name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.Description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

YAWN.Name: Yawn
YAWN.Description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

BELCH.Name: Belch
BELCH.Description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

GUNKSHOT.Name: Gunk Shot
GUNKSHOT.Description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

SLUDGEWAVE.Name: Sludge Wave
SLUDGEWAVE.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

SHELLSIDEARM.Name: Shell Side Arm
SHELLSIDEARM.Description: Inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. May also poison the target.

CROSSPOISON.Name: Cross Poison
CROSSPOISON.Description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.

VENOSHOCK.Name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.Description: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

CLEARSMOG.Name: Clear Smog
CLEARSMOG.Description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

POISONFANG.Name: Poison Fang
POISONFANG.Description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

POISONTAIL.Name: Poison Tail
POISONTAIL.Description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

ACID.Name: Acid
ACID.Description: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

ACIDSPRAY.Name: Acid Spray
ACIDSPRAY.Description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

SMOG.Name: Smog
SMOG.Description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

POISONSTING.Name: Poison Sting
POISONSTING.Description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

ACIDARMOR.Name: Acid Armor
ACIDARMOR.Description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

BANEFULBUNKER.Name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFULBUNKER.Description: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.

COIL.Name: Coil
COIL.Description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

CORROSIVEGAS.Name: Corrosive Gas
CORROSIVEGAS.Description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

GASTROACID.Name: Gastro Acid
GASTROACID.Description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid negates the effect of the target's Ability.

POISONGAS.Name: Poison Gas
POISONGAS.Description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

POISONPOWDER.Name: Poison Powder
POISONPOWDER.Description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

PURIFY.Name: Purify
PURIFY.Description: The user heals the target's status condition. If so, it also restores the user's own HP.

TOXICSPIKES.Name: Toxic Spikes
TOXICSPIKES.Description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

TOXICTHREAD.Name: Toxic Thread
TOXICTHREAD.Description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

VENOMDRENCH.Name: Venom Drench
VENOMDRENCH.Description: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

PRISMATICLASER.Name: Prismatic Laser
PRISMATICLASER.Description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

FUTURESIGHT.Name: Future Sight
FUTURESIGHT.Description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

SYNCHRONOISE.Name: Synchronoise
SYNCHRONOISE.Description: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages any Pokémon of the same type as the user.

PHOTONGEYSER.Name: Photon Geyser
PHOTONGEYSER.Description: The user attacks with a pillar of light. This move the higher of the user's Attack or Sp. Atk stat.

PSYSTRIKE.Name: Psystrike
PSYSTRIKE.Description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

FREEZINGGLARE.Name: Freezing Glare
FREEZINGGLARE.Description: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

PSYCHICFANGS.Name: Psychic Fangs
PSYCHICFANGS.Description: The user bites the target using psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

EERIESPELL.Name: Eerie Spell
EERIESPELL.Description: The user attacks with tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

EXPANDINGFORCE.Name: Expanding Force
EXPANDINGFORCE.Description: The user attacks the target with psychic power. Powers up and hits all foes on Psychic Terrain.

EXTRASENSORY.Name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.Description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

HYPERSPACEHOLE.Name: Hyperspace Hole
HYPERSPACEHOLE.Description: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. Skips protections.

PSYSHOCK.Name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.Description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

ZENHEADBUTT.Name: Zen Headbutt
ZENHEADBUTT.Description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

LUSTERPURGE.Name: Luster Purge
LUSTERPURGE.Description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

MISTBALL.Name: Mist Ball
MISTBALL.Description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.

PSYCHOCUT.Name: Psycho Cut
PSYCHOCUT.Description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

PSYBEAM.Name: Psybeam
PSYBEAM.Description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

HEARTSTAMP.Name: Heart Stamp
HEARTSTAMP.Description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the foe less wary. It may also cause flinching.

CONFUSION.Name: Confusion
CONFUSION.Description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

STOREDPOWER.Name: Stored Power
STOREDPOWER.Description: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

MIRRORCOAT.Name: Mirror Coat
MIRRORCOAT.Description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

PSYWAVE.Name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.Description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

AGILITY.Name: Agility
AGILITY.Description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

ALLYSWITCH.Name: Ally Switch
ALLYSWITCH.Description: The user switches places with an ally. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

AMNESIA.Name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.Description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

COSMICPOWER.Name: Cosmic Power
COSMICPOWER.Description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

GRAVITY.Name: Gravity
GRAVITY.Description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

GUARDSPLIT.Name: Guard Split
GUARDSPLIT.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target.

GUARDSWAP.Name: Guard Swap
GUARDSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

HEALBLOCK.Name: Heal Block
HEALBLOCK.Description: For five turns, the foe is prevented from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

HEALPULSE.Name: Heal Pulse
HEALPULSE.Description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

HEALINGWISH.Name: Healing Wish
HEALINGWISH.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

HEARTSWAP.Name: Heart Swap
HEARTSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

IMPRISON.Name: Imprison
IMPRISON.Description: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

INSTRUCT.Name: Instruct
INSTRUCT.Description: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.

KINESIS.Name: Kinesis
KINESIS.Description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.

LUNARDANCE.Name: Lunar Dance
LUNARDANCE.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

MAGICCOAT.Name: Magic Coat
MAGICCOAT.Description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

MAGICPOWDER.Name: Magic Powder
MAGICPOWDER.Description: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

MAGICROOM.Name: Magic Room
MAGICROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

MEDITATE.Name: Meditate
MEDITATE.Description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

MIRACLEEYE.Name: Miracle Eye
MIRACLEEYE.Description: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

POWERSPLIT.Name: Power Split
POWERSPLIT.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

POWERSWAP.Name: Power Swap
POWERSWAP.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

POWERTRICK.Name: Power Trick
POWERTRICK.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

PSYCHICTERRAIN.Name: Psychic Terrain
PSYCHICTERRAIN.Description: Protects grounded Pokémon from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

PSYCHOSHIFT.Name: Psycho Shift
PSYCHOSHIFT.Description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

SPEEDSWAP.Name: Speed Swap
SPEEDSWAP.Description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

TELEKINESIS.Name: Telekinesis
TELEKINESIS.Description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

TELEPORT.Name: Teleport
TELEPORT.Description: The user switches place with a party Pokémon. Also warps to the last Pokémon Center visited.

TRICK.Name: Trick
TRICK.Description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

WONDERROOM.Name: Wonder Room
WONDERROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

HEADSMASH.Name: Head Smash
HEADSMASH.Description: The user attacks the foe with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

ROCKWRECKER.Name: Rock Wrecker
ROCKWRECKER.Description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

METEORBEAM.Name: Meteor Beam
METEORBEAM.Description: Gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, attacks on the next turn.

DIAMONDSTORM.Name: Diamond Storm
DIAMONDSTORM.Description: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage foes. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.

POWERGEM.Name: Power Gem
POWERGEM.Description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

ANCIENTPOWER.Name: Ancient Power
ANCIENTPOWER.Description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

ROCKTHROW.Name: Rock Throw
ROCKTHROW.Description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

SMACKDOWN.Name: Smack Down
SMACKDOWN.Description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

ACCELEROCK.Name: Accelerock
ACCELEROCK.Description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

ROLLOUT.Name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.Description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

ROCKBLAST.Name: Rock Blast
ROCKBLAST.Description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

TARSHOT.Name: Tar Shot
TARSHOT.Description: Pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed and making it weaker to Fire-type moves.

WIDEGUARD.Name: Wide Guard
WIDEGUARD.Description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

DOOMDESIRE.Name: Doom Desire
DOOMDESIRE.Description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

STEELBEAM.Name: Steel Beam
STEELBEAM.Description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

STEELROLLER.Name: Steel Roller
STEELROLLER.Description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground isn't a terrain.

BEHEMOTHBASH.Name: Behemoth Bash
BEHEMOTHBASH.Description: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target.

BEHEMOTHBLADE.Name: Behemoth Blade
BEHEMOTHBLADE.Description: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target.

SUNSTEELSTRIKE.Name: Sunsteel Strike
SUNSTEELSTRIKE.Description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. Can't be stopped by the target's Ability.

METEORMASH.Name: Meteor Mash
METEORMASH.Description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.

ANCHORSHOT.Name: Anchor Shot
ANCHORSHOT.Description: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain. The target becomes unable to flee.

IRONHEAD.Name: Iron Head
IRONHEAD.Description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

SMARTSTRIKE.Name: Smart Strike
SMARTSTRIKE.Description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

DOUBLEIRONBASH.Name: Double Iron Bash
DOUBLEIRONBASH.Description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes twice. May cause flinching.

MIRRORSHOT.Name: Mirror Shot
MIRRORSHOT.Description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

MAGNETBOMB.Name: Magnet Bomb
MAGNETBOMB.Description: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

GEARGRIND.Name: Gear Grind
GEARGRIND.Description: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

METALCLAW.Name: Metal Claw
METALCLAW.Description: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

BULLETPUNCH.Name: Bullet Punch
BULLETPUNCH.Description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

METALBURST.Name: Metal Burst
METALBURST.Description: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.

AUTOTOMIZE.Name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.Description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

GEARUP.Name: Gear Up
GEARUP.Description: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk of allies with the Plus or Minus Ability.

IRONDEFENSE.Name: Iron Defense
IRONDEFENSE.Description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

KINGSSHIELD.Name: King's Shield
KINGSSHIELD.Description: Protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack of attackers that make contact.

METALSOUND.Name: Metal Sound
METALSOUND.Description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

SHIFTGEAR.Name: Shift Gear
SHIFTGEAR.Description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

HYDROCANNON.Name: Hydro Cannon
HYDROCANNON.Description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

WATERSPOUT.Name: Water Spout
WATERSPOUT.Description: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful it becomes.

HYDROPUMP.Name: Hydro Pump
HYDROPUMP.Description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

ORIGINPULSE.Name: Origin Pulse
ORIGINPULSE.Description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

STEAMERUPTION.Name: Steam Eruption
STEAMERUPTION.Description: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

CRABHAMMER.Name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.Description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

AQUATAIL.Name: Aqua Tail
AQUATAIL.Description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

MUDDYWATER.Name: Muddy Water
MUDDYWATER.Description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

SPARKLINGARIA.Name: Sparkling Aria
SPARKLINGARIA.Description: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed by these bubbles.

FISHIOUSREND.Name: Fishious Rend
FISHIOUSREND.Description: The user rends the target with its hard gills. Power doubles if the user moves first.

LIQUIDATION.Name: Liquidation
LIQUIDATION.Description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. May lower the target's Defense.

SNIPESHOT.Name: Snipe Shot
SNIPESHOT.Description: The user ignores any effects that redirect moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

WATERPLEDGE.Name: Water Pledge
WATERPLEDGE.Description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, it makes a rainbow.

RAZORSHELL.Name: Razor Shell
RAZORSHELL.Description: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

BUBBLEBEAM.Name: Bubble Beam
BUBBLEBEAM.Description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.

OCTAZOOKA.Name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.Description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe's face or eyes. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

FLIPTURN.Name: Flip Turn
FLIPTURN.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

WATERGUN.Name: Water Gun
WATERGUN.Description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

SURGINGSTRIKES.Name: Surging Strikes
SURGINGSTRIKES.Description: Hits three times in a row with mastery of the Water style. This attack always deals critical hits.

WATERSHURIKEN.Name: Water Shuriken
WATERSHURIKEN.Description: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first.

AQUARING.Name: Aqua Ring
AQUARING.Description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

LIFEDEW.Name: Life Dew
LIFEDEW.Description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its allies.

SOAK.Name: Soak
SOAK.Description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

WATERSPORT.Name: Water Sport
WATERSPORT.Description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

WITHDRAW.Name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.Description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

DIRECLAW.Name: Dire Claw
DIRECLAW.Description: The user may critically hit with its ruinous claws. May also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

SPRINGTIDESTORM.Name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDESTORM.Description: The user wraps winds of fierce emotion around opponents. This may lower their Attack stats.

RAGINGFURY.Name: Raging Fury
RAGINGFURY.Description: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

WAVECRASH.Name: Wave Crash
WAVECRASH.Description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target. This also damages the user.

CHLOROBLAST.Name: Chloroblast
CHLOROBLAST.Description: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

MOUNTAINGALE.Name: Mountain Gale
MOUNTAINGALE.Description: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target. This may also make the target flinch.

BARBBARRAGE.Name: Barb Barrage
BARBBARRAGE.Description: Fires toxic barbs which may poison the target. Power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

ESPERWING.Name: Esper Wing
ESPERWING.Description: The user slashes with aura-enriched wings which boosts its Speed stat. Critical hits land more easily.

BITTERMALICE.Name: Bitter Malice
BITTERMALICE.Description: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

TRIPLEARROWS.Name: Triple Arrows
TRIPLEARROWS.Description: The user fires arrows which may lower the target’s Defense or make it flinch. Critical hits land more easily.

BLEAKWINDSTORM.Name: Bleakwind Storm
BLEAKWINDSTORM.Description: The user attacks with cold winds that cause opposing Pokémon to tremble. This may lower their Speed stats.

WILDBOLTSTORM.Name: Wildbolt Storm
WILDBOLTSTORM.Description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a thunderous tempest. This may also leave them paralyzed.

SANDSEARSTORM.Name: Sandsear Storm
SANDSEARSTORM.Description: The user wraps fierce winds and hot sand around opponents. This may leave them with a burn.

LUNARBLESSING.Name: Lunar Blessing
LUNARBLESSING.Description: The user is blessed by the moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions of itself and allies.

PSYSHIELDBASH.Name: Psyshield Bash
PSYSHIELDBASH.Description: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This raises the user’s Defense.

POWERSHIFT.Name: Power Shift
POWERSHIFT.Description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

STONEAXE.Name: Stone Axe
STONEAXE.Description: The user swings at the opponent with its stone axes. May leave floating rocks around the target.

MYSTICALPOWER.Name: Mystical Power
MYSTICALPOWER.Description: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

VICTORYDANCE.Name: Victory Dance
VICTORYDANCE.Description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, raising its Attack, Defense, and Speed.

INFERNALPARADE.Name: Infernal Parade
INFERNALPARADE.Description: Hurls fireballs which may cause burns. Power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

CEASELESSEDGE.Name: Ceaseless Edge
CEASELESSEDGE.Description: The user slashes the opponent with its shell blade. May leave spikes around the target.

TAKEHEART.Name: Take Heart
TAKEHEART.Description: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

AQUACUTTER.Name: Aqua Cutter
AQUACUTTER.Description: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. Critical hits land more easily.

AQUASTEP.Name: Aqua Step
AQUASTEP.Description: The user attacks the target using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

ARMORCANNON.Name: Armor Cannon
ARMORCANNON.Description: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

AXEKICK.Name: Axe Kick
AXEKICK.Description: Performs a downward kick which may confuse the target. The user takes damage if it misses.

BITTERBLADE.Name: Bitter Blade
BITTERBLADE.Description: A spiteful slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

BLAZINGTORQUE.Name: Blazing Torque
BLAZINGTORQUE.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may leave the target with a burn.

CHILLINGWATER.Name: Chilling Water
CHILLINGWATER.Description: The user showers the target with frigid water. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

CHILLYRECEPTION.Name: Chilly Reception
CHILLYRECEPTION.Description: The user tells a chillingly bad joke and switches out. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

COLLISIONCOURSE.Name: Collision Course
COLLISIONCOURSE.Description: A massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

COMBATTORQUE.Name: Combat Torque
COMBATTORQUE.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may paralyze the target.

COMEUPPANCE.Name: Comeuppance
COMEUPPANCE.Description: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

DOODLE.Name: Doodle
DOODLE.Description: The user captures a quick sketch, changing the Abilities of the user and its allies to the target's.

DOUBLESHOCK.Name: Double Shock
DOUBLESHOCK.Description: The user attacks by discharging all of its electricity. The user will no longer be Electric type.

ELECTRODRIFT.Name: Electro Drift
ELECTRODRIFT.Description: A futuristic electric strike. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

FILLETAWAY.Name: Fillet Away
FILLETAWAY.Description: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

FLOWERTRICK.Name: Flower Trick
FLOWERTRICK.Description: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target, which always hits and lands a critical hit.

GIGATONHAMMER.Name: Gigaton Hammer
GIGATONHAMMER.Description: The user attacks with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

GLAIVERUSH.Name: Glaive Rush
GLAIVERUSH.Description: The user becomes highly vulnerable to attacks until its next turn after using this move.

HYPERDRILL.Name: Hyper Drill
HYPERDRILL.Description: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target, ignoring protections.

ICESPINNER.Name: Ice Spinner
ICESPINNER.Description: The user spins into the target with feet covered in thin ice. This also destroys the terrain.

JETPUNCH.Name: Jet Punch
JETPUNCH.Description: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. Always goes first.

KOWTOWCLEAVE.Name: Kowtow Cleave
KOWTOWCLEAVE.Description: The user kowtows to make the target lower its guard, then slashes. This attack never misses.

LASTRESPECTS.Name: Last Respects
LASTRESPECTS.Description: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The move’s power increases for each defeated ally.

LUMINACRASH.Name: Lumina Crash
LUMINACRASH.Description: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar, mind-bending light that harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def.

MAGICALTORQUE.Name: Magical Torque
MAGICALTORQUE.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may confuse the target.

MAKEITRAIN.Name: Make It Rain
MAKEITRAIN.Description: The user throws out a huge mass of coins, lowering its Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

MORTALSPIN.Name: Mortal Spin
MORTALSPIN.Description: Performs a spin that eliminates certain traps and hazards. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

NOXIOUSTORQUE.Name: Noxious Torque
NOXIOUSTORQUE.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may poison the target.

ORDERUP.Name: Order Up
ORDERUP.Description: If used when the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, a boost occurs based on its form.

POPULATIONBOMB.Name: Population Bomb
POPULATIONBOMB.Description: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits one to ten times in a row.

POUNCE.Name: Pounce
POUNCE.Description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

RAGEFIST.Name: Rage Fist
RAGEFIST.Description: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The move’s power increases every time the user is hit.

RAGINGBULL.Name: Raging Bull
RAGINGBULL.Description: The user charges and destroys enemy barriers. This move’s type depends on the user’s form.

REVIVALBLESSING.Name: Revival Blessing
REVIVALBLESSING.Description: The user revives a party Pokémon that has fainted and restores half their max HP.

RUINATION.Name: Ruination
RUINATION.Description: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

SALTCURE.Name: Salt Cure
SALTCURE.Description: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types take more damage.

SHEDTAIL.Name: Shed Tail
SHEDTAIL.Description: The user creates a substitute and switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

SILKTRAP.Name: Silk Trap
SILKTRAP.Description: User spins a silken trap to protect itself. Lowers the Speed of any that make direct contact.

SNOWSCAPE.Name: Snowscape
SNOWSCAPE.Description: Summons a five-turn snowstorm that boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon.

SPICYEXTRACT.Name: Spicy Extract
SPICYEXTRACT.Description: Emits a spicy extract which raises the target’s Attack and lowers Defense by two stages each.

SPINOUT.Name: Spin Out
SPINOUT.Description: The user inflicts damage on the target with a furious spin. This harshly lowers the user’s Speed.

TIDYUP.Name: Tidy Up
TIDYUP.Description: Clears hazards and substitutes from the field. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed.

TORCHSONG.Name: Torch Song
TORCHSONG.Description: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

TRAILBLAZE.Name: Trailblaze
TRAILBLAZE.Description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. This boosts the user's Speed stat.

TRIPLEDIVE.Name: Triple Dive
TRIPLEDIVE.Description: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target three times in a row.

TWINBEAM.Name: Twin Beam
TWINBEAM.Description: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

WICKEDTORQUE.Name: Wicked Torque
WICKEDTORQUE.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may put the target to sleep.

HYDROSTEAM.Name: Hydro Steam
HYDROSTEAM.Description: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water whose power is boosted in harsh sunlight.

PSYBLADE.Name: Psyblade
PSYBLADE.Description: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade whose power is boosted on Electric Terrain.

BLOODMOON.Name: Blood Moon
BLOODMOON.Description: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a blood moon. This move can't be used twice in a row.

MATCHAGOTCHA.Name: Matcha Gotcha
MATCHAGOTCHA.Description: Blasts opponents with hot tea. Heals the user by half the damage dealt and may also burn targets.

SYRUPBOMB.Name: Syrup Bomb
SYRUPBOMB.Description: An explosion of sticky candy syrup, which drop the target's Speed stat each turn for three turns.

IVYCUDGEL.Name: Ivy Cudgel
IVYCUDGEL.Description: An ivy-wrapped cudgel strike with a high critical-hit ratio. Type changes based on the user's Mask.

ELECTROSHOT.Name: Electro Shot
ELECTROSHOT.Description: A two-turn attack. The user boosts its Sp. Atk and then fires a high-voltage shot.

TERASTARSTORM.Name: Tera Starstorm
TERASTARSTORM.Description: When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

FICKLEBEAM.Name: Fickle Beam
FICKLEBEAM.Description: Sometimes all of the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling this move's power.

BURNINGBULWARK.Name: Burning Bulwark
BURNINGBULWARK.Description: Protects the user from attacks. Also burns any attacker that makes contact with the user.

THUNDERCLAP.Name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

MIGHTYCLEAVE.Name: Mighty Cleave
MIGHTYCLEAVE.Description: The user cleaves the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

TACHYONCUTTER.Name: Tachyon Cutter
TACHYONCUTTER.Description: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

HARDPRESS.Name: Hard Press
HARDPRESS.Description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

DRAGONCHEER.Name: Dragon Cheer
DRAGONCHEER.Description: The user raises its allies’ critical hit ratio with a draconic cry. This rouses Dragon types more.

ALLURINGVOICE.Name: Alluring Voice
ALLURINGVOICE.Description: Attacks using an angelic voice. This confuses the target if its stats have been raised this turn.

TEMPERFLARE.Name: Temper Flare
TEMPERFLARE.Description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

SUPERCELLSLAM.Name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELLSLAM.Description: The user drops onto the target with its electrified body. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

PSYCHICNOISE.Name: Psychic Noise
PSYCHICNOISE.Description: Attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. Prevents the target from healing for two turns.

UPPERHAND.Name: Upper Hand
UPPERHAND.Description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. Fails if the target isn't using a high priority move.

MALIGNANTCHAIN.Name: Malignant Chain
MALIGNANTCHAIN.Description: Wraps the target in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

TERABLAST.Name: Tera Blast
TERABLAST.Description: Mouvement dont le type diffère de celui de l'utilisateur dans le cas où celui-ci s'est téracristallisé.

SHELLARMOR.Name: Shell Armor
SHELLARMOR.Description: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

DOWNLOAD.Name: Download

ROCKHEAD.Name: Rock Head
ROCKHEAD.Description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

FOREWARN.Description: Determines what moves a foe has.

POISONHEAL.Description: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned.

STENCH.Name: Stench

BATTLEARMOR.Description: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

ROUGHSKIN.Description: Inflicts damage to the foe on contact.

EFFECTSPORE.Name: Effect Spore

SERENEGRACE.Name: Serene Grace

ILLUMINATE.Name: Illuminate
ILLUMINATE.Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering accuracy.

POISONPOINT.Name: Poison Point
POISONPOINT.Description: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

INNERFOCUS.Description: The Pokémon is protected from flinching.

MAGMAARMOR.Name: Magma Armor
MAGMAARMOR.Description: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

WATERVEIL.Name: Water Veil
WATERVEIL.Description: Prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

KEENEYE.Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering accuracy.

HYPERCUTTER.Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Attack stat.

QUICKFEET.Description: Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.

FLAREBOOST.Description: Powers up special attacks when burned.

SANDRUSH.Name: Sand Rush
SANDRUSH.Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in a sandstorm.

WONDERSKIN.Name: Wonder Skin

CAREFULMINT.Name: Careful Mint

SASSYMINT.Name: Sassy Mint

JOLLYMINT.Description: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.

NAIVEMINT.Description: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.

SERIOUSMINT.Name: Serious Mint
SERIOUSMINT.Description: When a Pokémon smells this mint, all of its stats will grow at an equal rate.

ABILITYCAPSULE.Name: Ability Capsule
ABILITYCAPSULE.Description: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.

ABILITYPATCH.Name: Ability Patch
ABILITYPATCH.Description: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

SUPERCAPSULE.Name: Super Capsule
SUPERCAPSULE.Description: A special capsule that allows a Pokémon to change its ability from among all the abilities it possesses.

EXPCANDYXS.Name: Exp. Candy XS
EXPCANDYXS.Description: A candy packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYS.Name: Exp. Candy S
EXPCANDYS.Description: A candy packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYM.Name: Exp. Candy M
EXPCANDYM.Description: A candy packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYL.Name: Exp. Candy L
EXPCANDYL.Description: A candy packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYXL.Name: Exp. Candy XL
EXPCANDYXL.Description: A candy packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

RARECANDY.Name: Rare Candy
RARECANDY.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

UNRARECANDY.Name: Bad Candy
UNRARECANDY.Description: Energy candy that lowers a Pokémon's level.

POKEBALL.Name: Poké Ball
POKEBALL.Description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

GREATBALL.Name: Great Ball
GREATBALL.Description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

ULTRABALL.Name: Ultra Ball
ULTRABALL.Description: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

MASTERBALL.Name: Master Ball
MASTERBALL.Description: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

SAFARIBALL.Name: Safari Ball
SAFARIBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Safari Zone. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

SPORTBALL.Name: Sport Ball
SPORTBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.

NETBALL.Name: Net Ball
NETBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

DIVEBALL.Name: Dive Ball
DIVEBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon that live underwater.

NESTBALL.Name: Nest Ball
NESTBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

REPEATBALL.Name: Repeat Ball
REPEATBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

TIMERBALL.Name: Timer Ball
TIMERBALL.Description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

LUXURYBALL.Name: Luxury Ball
LUXURYBALL.Description: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

PREMIERBALL.Name: Premier Ball
PREMIERBALL.Description: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

CHERISHBALL.Description: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.
CHERISHBALL.Name: Cherish Ball

DUSKBALL.Name: Dusk Ball
DUSKBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

HEALBALL.Name: Heal Ball
HEALBALL.Description: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon's HP and eliminates any status problem.

QUICKBALL.Name: Quick Ball
QUICKBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if used at the start of a wild encounter.

FASTBALL.Name: Fast Ball
FASTBALL.Description: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch fast Pokémon.

LEVELBALL.Name: Level Ball
LEVELBALL.Description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are a lower level than your own.

LUREBALL.Name: Lure Ball
LUREBALL.Description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.

HEAVYBALL.Name: Heavy Ball
HEAVYBALL.Description: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.

LOVEBALL.Name: Love Ball
LOVEBALL.Description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are the opposite gender of your Pokémon.

FRIENDBALL.Name: Friend Ball
FRIENDBALL.Description: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.

MOONBALL.Name: Moon Ball
MOONBALL.Description: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.

DREAMBALL.Name: Dream Ball
DREAMBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they're asleep.

BEASTBALL.Name: Beast Ball
BEASTBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball designed to catch Ultra Beasts. It has a low success rate for catching others.

TM01.Name: TM01
TM01.Description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

TM02.Name: TM02
TM02.Description: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

TM03.Name: TM03
TM03.Description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

TM04.Name: TM04
TM04.Description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

TM05.Name: TM05
TM05.Description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends the battle.

TM06.Name: TM06
TM06.Description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

TM07.Name: TM07
TM07.Description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

TM08.Name: TM08
TM08.Description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

TM09.Name: TM09
TM09.Description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

TM10.Name: TM10
TM10.Description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

TM11.Name: TM11
TM11.Description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves and weakening Water-type moves.

TM12.Name: TM12
TM12.Description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

TM13.Name: TM13
TM13.Description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

TM14.Name: TM14
TM14.Description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them frozen.

TM15.Name: TM15
TM15.Description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

TM16.Name: TM16
TM16.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

TM17.Name: TM17
TM17.Description: The user protects itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

TM18.Name: TM18
TM18.Description: The user summons a heavy rain for five turns, powering up Water-type moves and weakening Fire-type ones.

TM19.Name: TM19
TM19.Description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

TM20.Name: TM20
TM20.Description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

TM21.Name: TM21
TM21.Description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

TM22.Name: TM22
TM22.Description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

TM23.Name: TM23
TM23.Description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

TM24.Name: TM24
TM24.Description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

TM25.Name: TM25
TM25.Description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave them with paralysis.

TM26.Name: TM26
TM26.Description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

TM27.Name: TM27
TM27.Description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

TM28.Name: TM28
TM28.Description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

TM29.Name: TM29
TM29.Description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM30.Name: TM30
TM30.Description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM31.Name: TM31
TM31.Description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

TM32.Name: TM32
TM32.Description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

TM33.Name: TM33
TM33.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

TM34.Name: TM34
TM34.Description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

TM35.Name: TM35
TM35.Description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

TM36.Name: TM36
TM36.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

TM37.Name: TM37
TM37.Description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

TM38.Name: TM38
TM38.Description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave them with a burn.

TM39.Name: TM39
TM39.Description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by preventing its movement.

TM40.Name: TM40
TM40.Description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

TM41.Name: TM41
TM41.Description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

TM42.Name: TM42
TM42.Description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

TM43.Name: TM43
TM43.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

TM89.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
TM89.Name: TM89

TM44.Name: TM44
TM44.Description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and heals any status conditions.

TM45.Name: TM45
TM45.Description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

TM46.Name: TM46
TM46.Description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously.

TM47.Name: TM47
TM47.Description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user's Defense stat.

TM48.Name: TM48
TM48.Description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

TM49.Name: TM49
TM49.Description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

TM50.Name: TM50
TM50.Description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

TM51.Name: TM51
TM51.Description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

TM52.Name: TM52
TM52.Description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM53.Name: TM53
TM53.Description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM54.Name: TM54
TM54.Description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

TM55.Name: TM55
TM55.Description: If the target's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

TM56.Name: TM56
TM56.Description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

TM57.Name: TM57
TM57.Description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining charge to raise its Sp. Atk.

TM58.Name: TM58
TM58.Description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

TM59.Name: TM59
TM59.Description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

TM60.Name: TM60
TM60.Description: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

TM61.Name: TM61
TM61.Description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

TM62.Name: TM62
TM62.Description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM63.Name: TM63
TM63.Description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.

TM64.Name: TM64
TM64.Description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

TM65.Name: TM65
TM65.Description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

TM66.Name: TM66
TM66.Description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

TM67.Name: TM67
TM67.Description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

TM68.Name: TM68
TM68.Description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

TM69.Name: TM69
TM69.Description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

TM70.Name: TM70
TM70.Description: The user flashes a light that lowers the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

TM71.Name: TM71
TM71.Description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

TM72.Name: TM72
TM72.Description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

TM73.Name: TM73
TM73.Description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

TM74.Name: TM74
TM74.Description: The user tackles with a high-speed spin. This move is stronger the slower the user is than the target.

TM75.Name: TM75
TM75.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

TM76.Name: TM76
TM76.Description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team that hurt Pokémon that switch in.

TM77.Name: TM77
TM77.Description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

TM78.Name: TM78
TM78.Description: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

TM79.Name: TM79
TM79.Description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

TM80.Name: TM80
TM80.Description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make them flinch.

TM81.Name: TM81
TM81.Description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

TM82.Name: TM82
TM82.Description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

TM83.Name: TM83
TM83.Description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed of those hit.

TM84.Name: TM84
TM84.Description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison them.

TM85.Name: TM85
TM85.Description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.

TM86.Name: TM86
TM86.Description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the strong the move is.

TM87.Name: TM87
TM87.Description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

TM88.Name: TM88
TM88.Description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

TM90.Name: TM90
TM90.Description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as a decoy.

TM91.Name: TM91
TM91.Description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

TM92.Name: TM92
TM92.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

TM93.Name: TM93
TM93.Description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.

HM01.Description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.
HM01.Name: HM01

TM94.Name: TM94

HM02.Description: The user soars and then strikes on the next turn. This can also be used to fly to any familiar town.
HM02.Name: HM02

TM95.Name: TM95

HM03.Description: Attacks everything by swamping the surroundings with a giant wave. This can also be used to cross water.
HM03.Name: HM03

TM96.Name: TM96
TM96.Description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

HM04.Description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This can also be used to move heavy boulders.

TM100.Name: TM100

RESETURGE.Description: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.

ABILITYURGE.Description: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.

ITEMURGE.Description: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.

ITEMDROP.Name: Item Drop
ITEMDROP.Description: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.

BLUEFLUTE.Name: Blue Flute
BLUEFLUTE.Description: A blue flute made from blown glass. Its melody awakens a single Pokémon from sleep.

YELLOWFLUTE.Name: Yellow Flute
YELLOWFLUTE.Description: A yellow flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pokémon out of confusion.

REDFLUTE.Name: Red Flute
REDFLUTE.Description: A red flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pokémon out of infatuation.

POKEDOLL.Name: Poké Doll
POKEDOLL.Description: A doll that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

FLUFFYTAIL.Name: Fluffy Tail
FLUFFYTAIL.Description: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

POKETOY.Name: Poké Toy
POKETOY.Description: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

BICYCLE.Name: Bicycle
BICYCLE.Description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

OLDROD.Name: Old Rod
OLDROD.Description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

GOODROD.Name: Good Rod
GOODROD.Description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

SUPERROD.Name: Super Rod
SUPERROD.Description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

ITEMFINDER.Name: Itemfinder
ITEMFINDER.Description: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby when it is used, it emits a signal.

DOWSINGMACHINE.Name: Dowsing Machine
DOWSINGMACHINE.Description: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.

POKERADAR.Name: Poké Radar
POKERADAR.Description: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

TOWNMAP.Name: Town Map
TOWNMAP.Description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

ESCAPEROPE.Name: Escape Rope
ESCAPEROPE.Description: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.

COINCASE.Name: Coin Case
COINCASE.Description: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 99,999 coins.

POKEFLUTE.Name: Poké Flute
POKEFLUTE.Description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pokémon. It has a lovely tone.

SOOTSACK.Name: Soot Sack
SOOTSACK.Description: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.

SILPHSCOPE.Name: Silph Scope
SILPHSCOPE.Description: A scope that makes unseeable Pokémon visible. It is made by Silph Co.

DEVONSCOPE.Name: Devon Scope
DEVONSCOPE.Description: A device by Devon that signals any unseeable Pokémon.

SQUIRTBOTTLE.Name: Squirt Bottle
SQUIRTBOTTLE.Description: A watering can shaped like a Squirtle. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

SPRAYDUCK.Name: Sprayduck
SPRAYDUCK.Description: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

WAILMERPAIL.Name: Wailmer Pail
WAILMERPAIL.Description: A nifty watering pail. Use it to promote strong growth in Berries planted in soft soil.

SPRINKLOTAD.Name: Sprinklotad
SPRINKLOTAD.Description: A watering can shaped like a Lotad. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in soft soil.

GRACIDEA.Name: Gracidea
GRACIDEA.Description: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

REVEALGLASS.Name: Reveal Glass
REVEALGLASS.Description: A glass that reveals the truth. It is a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon back to its original shape.

PRISONBOTTLE.Name: Prison Bottle
PRISONBOTTLE.Description: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.

ROTOMCATALOG.Name: Rotom Catalog
ROTOMCATALOG.Description: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the devices listed within.

ZYGARDECUBE.Name: Zygarde Cube
ZYGARDECUBE.Description: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde's forms.

DNASPLICERS.Name: DNA Splicers
DNASPLICERS.Description: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

DNASPLICERSUSED.Name: DNA Splicers
DNASPLICERSUSED.Description: A splicer that separates Kyurem and a certain Pokémon when they have been fused.

NSOLARIZER.Name: N-Solarizer
NSOLARIZER.Description: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.

NSOLARIZERUSED.Name: N-Solarizer
NSOLARIZERUSED.Description: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Solgaleo.

NLUNARIZER.Name: N-Lunarizer
NLUNARIZER.Description: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.

NLUNARIZERUSED.Name: N-Lunarizer
NLUNARIZERUSED.Description: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Lunala.

REINSOFUNITY.Name: Reins of Unity
REINSOFUNITY.Description: Reins that people presented to the king. They unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

REINSOFUNITYUSED.Name: Reins of Unity
REINSOFUNITYUSED.Description: Reins that people presented to the king. They separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

OVALCHARM.Name: Oval Charm
OVALCHARM.Description: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Eggs being found at the Day Care.

SHINYCHARM.Name: Shiny Charm
SHINYCHARM.Description: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon.

CATCHINGCHARM.Name: Catching Charm
CATCHINGCHARM.Description: A charm said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. The charm doesn't shake much.

EXPCHARM.Name: Exp. Charm
EXPCHARM.Description: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside it.

MEGARING.Name: Mega Ring
MEGARING.Description: This ring contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve.

POKEMONBOXLINK.Name: Pokémon Box Link
POKEMONBOXLINK.Description: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won't work.

AURORATICKET.Name: Aurora Ticket
AURORATICKET.Description: A ticket required to board the ship to Doxy Island. It glows beautifully.

OLDSEAMAP.Name: Old Sea Map
OLDSEAMAP.Description: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.

BLACKAUGURITE.Name: Black Augurite
BLACKAUGURITE.Description: A glassy black stone that produces a sharp cutting edge when split. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

PEATBLOCK.Name: Peat Block
PEATBLOCK.Description: A block of muddy material that is for fuel. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

LINKINGCORD.Name: Linking Cord
LINKINGCORD.Description: A string exuding a mysterious energy of connection. It’s loved by certain Pokémon.

ADAMANTCRYSTAL.Name: Adamant Crystal
ADAMANTCRYSTAL.Description: When held by Dialga, this large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

LUSTROUSGLOBE.Name: Lustrous Globe
LUSTROUSGLOBE.Description: When held by Palkia, this large, glowing orb wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

LEGENDPLATE.Name: Legend Plate
LEGENDPLATE.Description: A stone tablet to be held by a certain Pokémon. It the holder the power of every type there is.

BLANKPLATE.Name: Blank Plate
BLANKPLATE.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

GRISEOUSCORE.Name: Griseous Core
GRISEOUSCORE.Description: When held by Giratina, this large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

AUSPICIOUSARMOR.Name: Auspicious Armor
AUSPICIOUSARMOR.Description: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain Pokémon evolve. Auspicious wishes live within it.

MALICIOUSARMOR.Name: Malicious Armor
MALICIOUSARMOR.Description: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain Pokémon evolve. Malicious will lurks within it.

SCROLLOFDARKNESS.Name: Scroll of Darkness
SCROLLOFDARKNESS.Description: A scroll that evolves certain Pokémon. Written on it are the true secrets of the path of darkness.

SCROLLOFWATERS.Name: Scroll of Waters
SCROLLOFWATERS.Description: A scroll that evolves certain Pokémon. Written on it are the true secrets of the path of water.

LEADERSCREST.Name: Leader's Crest
LEADERSCREST.Description: A shard of what appears to be an old blade of some sort. It is held only by a head of certain Pokémon group.

BOOSTERENERGY.Name: Booster Energy
BOOSTERENERGY.Description: An item to be held by Pokémon with certain Abilities. It boosts the strength of the Pokémon.

ABILITYSHIELD.Name: Ability Shield
ABILITYSHIELD.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This shield protects the holder from having its Ability changed by others.

CLEARAMULET.Name: Clear Amulet
CLEARAMULET.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It protects the holder from having its stats lowered.

MIRRORHERB.Name: Mirror Herb
MIRRORHERB.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This herb will allow the holder to mirror an opponent's stat increases once.

PUNCHINGGLOVE.Name: Punching Glove
PUNCHINGGLOVE.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holder's punching moves and prevents direct contact.

COVERTCLOAK.Name: Covert Cloak
COVERTCLOAK.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It conceals the holder, protecting it from move's additional effects.

LOADEDDICE.Name: Loaded Dice
LOADEDDICE.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It ensures the holder's multistrike moves hit more times.

GIMMIGHOULCOIN.Name: Gimmighoul Coin
GIMMIGHOULCOIN.Description: An item that accidentally dropped by a Pokémon. It seems that Gimmighoul treasure and hoard these.

TINYBAMBOOSHOOT.Name: Tiny Bamboo Shoot
TINYBAMBOOSHOOT.Description: A small and rare bamboo shoot. It's quite popular with a certain class of gourmands.

BIGBAMBOOSHOOT.Name: Big Bamboo Shoot
BIGBAMBOOSHOOT.Description: A large and rare bamboo shoot. It's extremely popular with a certain class of gourmands.

SCARLETBOOK.Name: Scarlet Book
SCARLETBOOK.Description: A record of the Heath's expedition on the Great Crater of Paldea. It has the name "Sada" written on it.

VIOLETBOOK.Name: Violet Book
VIOLETBOOK.Description: A record of the Heath's expedition on the Great Crater of Paldea. It has the name "Turo" written on it.

HEALTHMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's HP stat.

FRESHSTARTMOCHI.Name: Fresh-Start Mochi
FRESHSTARTMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It causes a Pokémon to lose all its base points.

MUSCLEMOCHI.Name: Muscle Mochi
MUSCLEMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's Attack stat.

RESISTMOCHI.Name: Resist Mochi
RESISTMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's Defense stat.

GENIUSMOCHI.Name: Genius Mochi
GENIUSMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat.

CLEVERMOCHI.Name: Clever Mochi
CLEVERMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's Sp. Def stat.

SWIFTMOCHI.Name: Swift Mochi
SWIFTMOCHI.Description: A mochi cake with Berries kneaded into its dough. It increases base points for a Pokémon's Speed stat.

FAIRYFEATHER.Name: Fairy Feather
FAIRYFEATHER.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves.

SYRUPYAPPLE.Name: Syrupy Apple
SYRUPYAPPLE.Description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally syrupy.

UNREMARKABLETEACUP.Name: Unremarkable Teacup
UNREMARKABLETEACUP.Description: A peculiar cracked teacup that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It makes delicious tea.

MASTERPIECETEACUP.Name: Masterpiece Teacup
MASTERPIECETEACUP.Description: A peculiar chipped teacup that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It makes delicious tea.

TEALMASK.Name: Teal Mask
TEALMASK.Description: A teal mask patterned after the face of an ogre. Dropped by Ogerpon after visiting the Festival of Masks.

METALALLOY.Name: Metal Alloy
METALALLOY.Description: A peculiar metal that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is composed of many layers.

INDIGODISK.Name: Indigo Disk
INDIGODISK.Description: A mysterious disk with an indigo shine to it, given by the Top Champion. It seems to be tied to Area Zero.

MYTHICALPECHABERRY.Name: Mythical Pecha Berry
MYTHICALPECHABERRY.Description: A Pecha Berry of the highest quality. It's one of every a few years berry that carefully tended by an expert.

INFREPEL.Name: Infinite Repel
INFREPEL.Description: A repellent that never runs out. You can turn it on and off.

RADAR.Name: Encounter Radar
RADAR.Description: A device that displays the encounter list for the current area.

VIAL.Name: Pocket Center
VIAL.Description: A limited-use device that allows you to heal your entire team. It recharges at Pokémon Centers.

EMPTYVIAL.Name: Pocket Center
EMPTYVIAL.Description: A limited-use device that allows you to heal your entire team. It recharges at Pokémon Centers. Empty.

EGGHATCHER.Name: Incubator
EGGHATCHER.Description: Incubator that allows you to keep 6 eggs until they hatch.

CHANGEDEX.Name: ChangeDex
CHANGEDEX.Description: A record of canon and Vermeil changes for existing species, including typing, stats, abilities and newly learned moves.
